1.1:
Ashrĕ is the man who shall not walk in the counsel of the wicked, 
And shall not stand in the path of sinners, 
And shall not sit in the seat of scoffers,
1.2:
But his delight is in the Torah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And he meditates in His Torah day and night.
1.3:
For he shall be as a tree 
Planted by the rivers of water, 
That yields its fruit in its season, 
And whose leaf does not wither, 
And whatever he does prospers.
1.4:
The wicked are not so, 
But are like the chaff which the wind blows away.
1.5:
Therefore the wicked shall not rise in the judgment, 
Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
1.6:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 knows the way of the righteous, 
But the way of the wicked comes to naught.

10.1:
Why do You stand afar off, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Hiding in times of distress?
10.2:
In arrogance the wicked hotly pursues the poor; 
They are caught by the schemes which they devised.
10.3:
For the wicked boasted of his cravings; 
And the greedy one cursed and despised 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
10.4:
In the pride of his face 
The wicked does not seek, 
In all his thoughts there is no Elohim!
10.5:
His ways are always prosperous! 
Your Right-Rulings are on high, out of his sight! 
He snorts at all his adversaries!
10.6:
He has said in his heart, “I shall not be moved; 
From generation to generation, never be in evil!”
10.7:
His mouth is filled with cursing and deceit and oppression; 
Under his tongue is trouble and wickedness.
10.10:
And he crouches, he lies low, 
And the helpless fall under his strength.
10.11:
He has said in his heart, “Ĕl has forgotten, 
He has hidden His face, 
He shall never see.”
10.12:
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
O Ĕl, lift up Your hand! 
Do not forget the lowly ones.
10.13:
Why do the wicked scorn Elohim? 
He has said in his heart, “It is not required.”
10.14:
You have seen it, for You observe trouble and grief, 
To repay with Your hand. 
The poor commits himself to You; 
You are the helper of the fatherless.
10.15:
Break the arm of the wicked and the evil one; 
Search out his wickedness that would not be found out.
10.16:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is Meleḵ forever and ever; 
The gentiles shall perish from His land.
10.17:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, You have heard the desire of the lowly ones; 
You prepare their heart; You incline Your ear,
10.18:
To defend the fatherless and the down-trodden; 
So that man who is of the earth no longer oppresses!

100.1:
A psalm of thanksgiving. Raise a shout for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
All the earth!
100.2:
Serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with gladness; 
Come before His presence with singing.
100.4:
Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, 
And into His courts with praise. 
Give thanks to Him; baraḵ His Name.

101.1:
A psalm of Dawiḏ. I sing of kindness and right-ruling; 
To You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I sing praises.
101.2:
I act wisely in a perfect way. 
When do You come to me? 
I walk in the midst of my house with a perfect heart.
101.4:
A perverse heart turns away from me; 
I do not know evil.
101.6:
My eyes are on the trustworthy of the land, 
To dwell with me; 
He who walks in a perfect way, 
He serves me.
101.7:
He who practices deceit 
Does not dwell in my house; 
He who speaks lies 
Does not stand in my presence.
101.8:
Each morning I uproot all the wicked of the land, 
To cut off all the workers of wickedness 
From the city of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.

102.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, hear my prayer, 
And let my cry come to You.
102.3:
For my days are consumed like smoke, 
And my bones are burned like a hearth.
102.4:
My heart is stricken and withered like grass, 
For I have forgotten to eat my bread.
102.5:
Because of the sound of my sighing 
My bones have clung to my flesh.
102.6:
I have been like a pelican of the wilderness, 
I have been like an owl of the desert.
102.7:
I have watched, and I am 
As a bird alone on the house-top.
102.8:
My enemies reproached me all day long, 
Those who rave against me have sworn against me.
102.9:
For I have eaten ashes like bread, 
And mixed my drink with tears,
102.11:
My days are like a shadow that lengthens, 
And I wither away like grass.
102.12:
But You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, shall be enthroned forever, 
And the remembrance of You be to all generations.
102.13:
You Yourself shall arise 
And have compassion on Tsiyon, 
For the time to favor her, 
The appointed time, has come.
102.14:
For Your servants have been pleased with her stones, 
And they favor her dust.
102.15:
And the nations shall revere the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And all the melaḵim of the earth Your esteem,
102.16:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall build up Tsiyon, 
He shall appear in His esteem.
102.17:
He shall turn unto the prayer of the destitute, 
And He shall not despise their prayer.
102.18:
This is written for a generation to come, 
So that a people to be created praise Yah.
102.20:
To hear the groaning of the prisoner, 
To release those appointed to death,
102.21:
To declare the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in Tsiyon, 
And His praise in Yerushalayim,
102.22:
When peoples gather together, 
And reigns, to serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
102.23:
He has humbled my strength in the way; 
He has shortened my days.
102.25:
“You founded the earth of old, 
And the shamayim are the work of Your hands.
102.27:
“But You are the same, 
And Your years have no end.
102.28:
“The sons of Your servants continue, 
And their seed is established before You.”

103.1:
Of Dawiḏ. Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O my being, 
And all that is within me, 
His qodesh Name!
103.2:
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O my being, 
And do not forget all His dealings,
103.3:
Who forgives all your wickednesses, 
Who heals all your diseases,
103.4:
Who redeems your ḥai from destruction, 
Who crowns you with kindness and compassion,
103.5:
Who satisfies your desire with the good, 
Your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
103.6:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is doing righteousness 
And right-ruling for all the oppressed.
103.7:
He made known His Ways to Mosheh, 
His acts to the children of Yisra’ĕl.
103.8:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is compassionate and showing favor, 
Patient, and great in kindness.
103.9: He does not always strive, nor maintain it forever.
103.10:
He has not done to us according to our sins, 
Nor rewarded us according to our wickednesses.
103.11:
For as the shamayim are high above the earth, 
So great is His kindness toward those who revere Him;
103.12:
As far as east is from west, 
So far has He removed our transgressions from us.
103.13:
As a father has compassion for his children, 
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has compassion for those who revere Him.
103.14:
For He knows how we are made; 
He remembers that we are dust.
103.15:
A man’s days are as grass: 
As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
103.16:
For the wind blows over it, and it is no more, 
And its place no longer remembers it.
103.17:
But the kindness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
Is from everlasting to everlasting 
Upon those who revere Him, 
And His righteousness to children’s children,
103.18:
To those who guard His Covenant, 
And to those who remember His Orders to do them.
103.19:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has established His throne in the shamayim, 
And His Malḵuth shall rule over all.
103.20:
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, you His messengers, 
Mighty in power, who do His Word, 
Listening to the voice of His Word.
103.21:
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, all you His hosts, 
You His servants, who do His pleasure.
103.22:
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, all His works, 
In all places of His rule. 
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O my being!

104.1:
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O my being!
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim,
You have been very great:
You have put on excellency and splendor,
104.2:
Covering Yourself with light as with a garment,
Stretching out the shamayim like a curtain,
104.3:
Who is laying the beams of His upper rooms in the waters,
Who is making thick clouds His chariot,
Who is walking on the wings of the wind,
104.4:
Making His messengers the winds, 
His servants a flame of fire.
104.5:
He established the earth on its foundations, 
So that it would not totter forever,
104.6:
You covered it with the deep as with a garment; 
The waters stood above the mountains.
104.7:
At Your rebuke they flee; 
At the voice of Your thunder they hurry away.
104.9:
You put a boundary, they do not pass over, 
They do not return to cover the earth.
104.10:
Who is sending the springs into the valleys, 
They flow among the hills.
104.11:
They give drink to every beast of the field; 
Wild donkeys break their thirst.
104.12:
The birds of the shamayim dwell beside them; 
They sing from between the branches.
104.13:
Watering the hills from His upper rooms; 
The earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.
104.14:
Causing the grass to grow for the cattle, 
And plants for the service of mankind, 
To bring forth food from the earth,
104.15:
And wine that makes glad the heart of man, 
Oil to make the face shine, 
And bread which sustains man’s heart.
104.16:
The trees of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 are satisfied, 
The cedars of Leḇanon which He planted,
104.17:
Where the birds make nests; 
The stork has her home in the fir trees.
104.18:
The high hills are for wild goats; 
Rocks, a refuge for rock badgers.
104.19:
He made the moon for appointed times; 
The sun knows it’s going down.
104.20:
You put darkness, and it is night, 
In it, all the beasts of the forest creep.
104.21:
The young lions are roaring for prey, 
And seeking their food from Ĕl.
104.22:
The sun arises - they withdraw 
And lie down in their dens.
104.23:
Man goes out to his work, 
And to his labor, till evening.
104.24:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, how many have been Your works! 
You have made all of them in wisdom. 
The earth is filled with Your possessions.
104.25:
There is the sea, great and wide, 
In which are innumerable swarms, 
Living creatures, small with great.
104.26:
There do ships go; 
That Liwiathan which You made, to play there.
104.27:
All of them wait for You, 
To give their food in due season.
104.28:
You give to them, they gather in; 
You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good.
104.29:
You hide Your face, they are alarmed; 
You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust;
104.30:
You send forth Your Ruaḥ, they are created; 
And You renew the face of the earth.
104.31:
The esteem of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is forever, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 rejoices in His works,
104.32:
Who looks on the earth, and it trembles; 
He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
104.33:
I sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 as long as I live, 
I sing praise to my Elohim while I exist.
104.34:
My meditation on Him is sweet; 
I rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
104.35:
Let sinners be consumed from the earth, 
And let the wicked be no more. 
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O my being! 
Hallelu-Yah!

105.1:
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
Call upon His Name, 
Make known His deeds among the peoples.
105.2:
Sing to Him, sing praise to Him; 
Speak of all His wonders.
105.3:
Make your boast in His qodesh Name; 
Let the hearts rejoice of those seeking 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
105.4:
Seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and His strength; 
Seek His face always.
105.5:
Remember His wonders which He has done, 
His miracles, and the Right-Rulings of His mouth,
105.6:
O seed of Aḇraham His servant, 
Children of Ya’aqoḇ, His chosen ones!
105.7:
He is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim; 
His Right-Rulings are in all the earth.
105.8:
He has remembered His Covenant forever, 
The Word He commanded, for a thousand generations,
105.9:
That He made with Aḇraham, 
And His oath to Yitsḥaq,
105.10:
And established it to Ya’aqoḇ for a Law, 
To Yisra’ĕl - an everlasting Covenant,
105.11:
Saying, “To you I give the land of Kena’an, 
The portion of your inheritance.”
105.12:
When they were few in number, 
Few indeed, and sojourners in it,
105.13:
And they went about from one nation to another, 
From one reign to another people,
105.14:
He allowed no one to oppress them, 
And He reproved melaḵim for their sakes,
105.15:
“Do not touch My anointed ones, 
And do My neḇi’im no evil.”
105.16:
And He called for a scarcity of food in the land; 
He cut off all the supply of bread.
105.17:
He sent ahead of them a man, 
Yosĕph, sold as a slave.
105.18:
They afflicted his feet with shackles, 
His neck was put in irons.
105.19:
Until the time that His Word came, 
The Word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 refined him.
105.20:
The meleḵ sent and released him, 
The ruler of the people let him loose.
105.21:
He made him master of his house, 
And ruler over all his possessions,
105.22:
To bind his chiefs at his pleasure, 
And to teach his elders wisdom.
105.23:
Then Yisra’ĕl came to Mitsrayim, 
And Ya’aqoḇ sojourned in the land of Ḥam.
105.24:
And He increased His people greatly, 
And made them stronger than their enemies.
105.25:
He turned their heart to hate His people, 
To conspire against His servants.
105.26:
He sent Mosheh His servant, 
Aharon whom He had chosen.
105.27:
They put among them the matters of His signs, 
And wonders in the land of Ḥam.
105.28:
He sent darkness, and made it dark; 
And they did not rebel against His Word.
105.29:
He turned their waters into blood, 
And killed their fish.
105.30:
Their land teemed with frogs, 
In the rooms of their melaḵim.
105.31:
He spoke, and swarms of flies came, 
Gnats in all their borders.
105.32:
He gave them hail for rain, 
A flaming fire in their land.
105.33:
And He smote their vines and their fig trees, 
And broke the trees of their borders.
105.34:
He spoke, and locusts came, 
And larvae, innumerable,
105.35:
And they devoured all the plants in their land, 
And they devoured the fruit of their ground.
105.36:
Then He smote all the first-born in their land, 
The first-fruit of all their strength,
105.37:
And brought them out with silver and gold, 
And among His tribes no one faltered.
105.38:
Mitsrayim was glad when they left, 
For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
105.39:
He spread a cloud for a covering, 
And fire to give light in the night.
105.40:
They asked, and He brought quail, 
And satisfied them with the bread of the shamayim.
105.41:
He opened the rock, and water gushed out; 
It ran in the dry places, a river.
105.42:
For He remembered His qodesh Word, 
To Aḇraham His servant.
105.43:
So He brought out His people with joy, 
His chosen ones with singing.
105.44:
And He gave to them the lands of the gentiles, 
And they inherited the labor of peoples,
105.45:
In order that they might guard His Laws, 
And watch over His Torot. Hallelu- Yah!

106.1:
Hallelu-Yah! Oh, give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
For He is good! 
For His kindness is everlasting.
106.2:
Who relates the mighty acts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? 
Or declare all His praise?
106.3:
Ashrĕ are those who guard Right-Ruling, 
Who do righteousness at all times!
106.4:
Remember me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, in the acceptance of Your people; 
Visit me with Your deliverance,
106.5:
To see the good of Your chosen ones, 
To rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, 
To make my boast with Your inheritance.
106.6:
We have sinned with our fathers, 
We have acted perversely, 
We have done wickedly.
106.8:
But He saved them for His Name’s sake, 
To make known His might.
106.10:
And He saved them from the hand of the hater, 
And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
106.11:
And waters covered their adversaries; 
Not one of them was left.
106.12:
Then they believed His words; 
They sang His praise.
106.13:
They soon forgot His works; 
They did not wait for His counsel,
106.14:
But greedily lusted in the wilderness, 
And tried Ĕl in the desert.
106.15:
And He gave them their request, 
But sent leanness within their being.
106.16:
And they were jealous of Mosheh in the camp, 
Of Aharon, the qodeshi of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
106.17:
The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, 
And covered the company of Aḇiram.
106.18:
And a fire burned in their company; 
A flame consumed the wicked.
106.19:
They made a calf in Ḥorĕḇ, 
And bowed down to a molded image.
106.20:
Thus they changed My esteem 
Into the form of an ox that eats grass.
106.21:
They forgot Ĕl their Savior, 
The Doer of greatness in Mitsrayim,
106.22:
Of wonders in the land of Ḥam, 
Of fear by the Sea of Reeds.
106.23:
Then He said that He would destroy them, 
Had not Mosheh His chosen one stood before Him in the breach, 
To turn away His wrath from destroying.
106.24:
They then despised the pleasant land; 
They did not believe His word,
106.25:
And they grumbled in their tents, 
They did not listen to the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
106.26:
So He lifted up His hand against them, 
To make them fall in the wilderness,
106.27:
And to make their seed fall among the gentiles, 
And to scatter them in the lands.
106.28:
And they joined themselves to Ba’al Pe’or, 
And ate slaughterings made to the dead.
106.29:
Thus they provoked Him with their deeds, 
And the plague broke out among them.
106.30:
Then Pineḥas stood up and intervened, 
And the plague was stopped.
106.31:
And that was reckoned to him for righteousness, 
To all generations forever.
106.32:
And they provoked wrath at the waters of Meriḇah, 
And Mosheh suffered on account of them;
106.33:
Because they embittered his spirit, 
And he spoke rashly with his lips.
106.34:
They did not destroy the peoples, 
As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had commanded them,
106.35:
But mixed with the gentiles 
And learned their works,
106.36:
And served their idols, 
And they became a snare to them.
106.37:
And they slaughtered their sons 
And their daughters to demons,
106.38:
And they shed innocent blood, 
The blood of their sons and daughters, 
Whom they offered to the idols of Kena’an; 
And the land was defiled with blood.
106.39:
So they became unclean by their own works, 
And went whoring by their own deeds.
106.40:
And the wrath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 burned against His people, 
And He loathed His own inheritance.
106.41:
Then He gave them into the hand of the gentiles, 
And those who hated them ruled over them.
106.42:
And their enemies oppressed them, 
And they were humbled under their hand.
106.44:
But He would look on their distress, 
When He heard their cry,
106.45:
And remember His Covenant for their sake, 
And relent according to the greatness of His kindness.
106.46:
And He would let them find compassion, 
Before all those holding them captive.
106.47:
Save us, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim, 
And gather us from among the gentiles, 
To give thanks to Your qodesh Name, 
To exult in Your praise.
106.48:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl 
From everlasting to everlasting! 
And all the people shall say, 
“Amĕn!” 
Hallelu-Yah!

107.1:
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
For goodness, 
For His kindness is everlasting.
107.2:
Let the redeemed of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 say, 
Whom He has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,
107.3:
And gathered out of the lands, 
From east and from west, 
From north and from south.
107.4:
They wandered in a wilderness, in a desert way; 
They found no city to dwell in.
107.5:
Hungry and thirsty, 
Their being in them grew faint.
107.6:
Then they cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in their distress, 
He delivered them out of their troubles.
107.7:
And He guided them by the right way, 
To go to a city to settle.
107.8:
Let them give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for His kindness, 
And His wonders to the children of men!
107.9:
For He has satisfied a longing being, 
And has filled the hungry being with goodness.
107.10:
Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, 
Bound in affliction and irons,
107.11:
Because they rebelled against the Words of Ĕl, 
And despised the counsel of the Most High.
107.12:
And He humbled their heart by toil; 
They stumbled, and there was no one to help.
107.13:
And they cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in their distress, 
And He saved them out of their troubles.
107.14:
He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, 
And He broke their chains in pieces.
107.15:
Let them give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for His kindness, 
And His wonders to the children of men!
107.16:
For He has broken the gates of bronze, 
And He cut the bars of iron in two.
107.17:
Fools, because of their transgression, 
And because of their wickednesses, were afflicted.
107.18:
Their being loathed all food, 
And they drew near to the gates of death,
107.19:
And cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in their distress, 
He saved them out of their troubles.
107.20:
He sent His Word and healed them, 
And delivered them from their destructions.
107.21:
Let them give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for His kindness, 
And His wonders to the children of men!
107.22:
And let them bring slaughterings of thanksgiving, 
And relate His works with rejoicing.
107.23:
Those who go down to the sea in ships, 
Doing work in many waters,
107.24:
They see the works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And His wonders in the deep.
107.25:
For He commands and raises the stormy wind, 
Which lifts up the waves of the sea.
107.27:
They dance and stagger like a drunkard, 
And all their wisdom is swallowed up.
107.28:
Then they cry out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in their distress, 
And He brings them out of their troubles.
107.29:
He caused the storm to be still, 
So that its waves were silent.
107.30:
And they rejoice because they are hushed; 
And He leads them to the haven of their delight.
107.31:
Let them give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 for His kindness, 
And His wonders to the children of men!
107.32:
And let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people, 
And praise Him in the seat of the elders.
107.33:
He makes rivers become a wilderness, 
And the fountains of water become a dry ground;
107.34:
A land of fruit becomes a salty desert, 
For the evil of those who dwell in it.
107.35:
He makes a wilderness become a pool of water, 
And dry land become fountains of waters.
107.36:
And He causes the hungry to dwell there, 
And they build a city to settle in,
107.37:
And they sow fields and plant vineyards, 
And they make fruits of increase.
107.39:
But when they are diminished and brought low 
Through oppression, evil and sorrow,
107.40:
He pours scorn on nobles, 
And causes them to wander in a pathless waste;
107.41:
But He raises the poor up from affliction, 
And makes clans like a flock.
107.42:
The straight ones see, and rejoice, 
And all unrighteousness shuts its mouth.
107.43:
Who is wise? 
Then let him observe these! 
Let them understand the kindnesses of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.

108.1:
O Elohim, my heart is steadfast; 
I sing and give praise - even my esteem.
108.2:
Awake, harp and lyre! 
I awake the dawn.
108.3:
I praise You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, among peoples, 
And I sing praises to You among the nations.
108.4:
For Your kindness is great above the shamayim, 
And Your truth reaches to the clouds.
108.5:
Exalt Yourself above the shamayim, O Elohim, 
And Your esteem above all the earth;
108.6:
In order that those You love Might be delivered. 
Save with Your right hand, 
And answer me.
108.7:
Elohim has spoken in His qodeshah, 
“I exult, I portion out Sheḵem, 
And I measure out the Valley of Sukkoth.
108.8:
“Gil’aḏ is Mine, Menashsheh is Mine, 
And Ephrayim is My chief defense, 
Yahuḏah is My lawgiver.
108.9:
“Mo’aḇ is My wash-pot, 
Over Eḏom I cast My shoe, 
Over Pelesheth I raise a shout.”
108.10:
Who would bring me into the strong city? 
Who shall lead me to Eḏom?
108.11:
Have You not rejected us, O Elohim? 
And You do not go out with our armies, O Elohim!
108.12:
Give us help from distress, 
For the help of man is naught.
108.13:
In Elohim we do mightily, 
For it is He who treads down our adversaries.

109.1: To the chief singer. A psalm, of Dawiḏ. Do not be silent, O Elohim of my praise!
109.2:
For the mouth of the wicked 
And the mouth of the deceiver 
Have opened against me; 
They have spoken against me with a false tongue.
109.3:
They have surrounded me with words of hatred, 
And they attack me without a cause.
109.4:
In return for my love they accuse me, 
While I am in prayer.
109.5:
And they repay me evil for good, 
And hatred for my love.
109.6:
Appoint over him one who is wicked, 
And let an accuser stand at his right hand.
109.7:
When he is judged, let him be found wicked, 
And let his prayer become sin.
109.8:
Let his days be few, 
Let another take his office.
109.9:
Let his children be fatherless, 
And his wife a widow.
109.10:
And let his children always wander and beg, 
And seek out of their ruins.
109.11:
Let the creditor lay a snare for all that he has, 
And let strangers plunder his labor.
109.12:
Let him have no one to extend kindness, 
Nor any to show favor to his fatherless children.
109.13:
Let his descendants be cut off, 
Their name be blotted out in the next generation.
109.14:
Let the wickedness of his fathers 
Be remembered before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
109.15:
Let them always be before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And let Him cut off their remembrance from the earth;
109.17:
He also loved cursing, so let it come to him; 
And he did not delight in beraḵah, so let it be far from him.
109.18:
And he put cursing on as with his garment, 
So let it enter his inward parts like water, 
And like oil into his bones.
109.19:
Let it be to him like a cloak he wraps around him, 
And as a girdle that he always girds on.
109.20:
This is the reward of my accusers from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And to those speaking evil against my being.
109.22:
For I am poor and needy, 
And my heart is pierced within me.
109.23:
I have gone like a lengthening shadow, 
I have been driven away like a locust.
109.24:
My knees are weak through fasting, 
And my flesh grows lean from fatness.
109.25:
And I, I have become a reproach to them; 
They see me, they shake their heads.
109.26:
Help me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim! 
Save me according to Your kindness,
109.27:
And let them know that this is Your hand. 
You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, You have done it!
109.28:
Let them curse, but You baraḵ. 
They shall arise, but be ashamed, 
And let Your servant rejoice.
109.29:
Let my accusers put on shame, 
And be wrapped in their own confusion as in a cloak.
109.30:
I greatly thank 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with my mouth, 
And I praise Him in the midst of the throng.
109.31:
For He stands at the right hand of the poor, 
To save from those judging his being.

11.2:
For look! The wicked bend a bow, 
They ready their arrow on the string, 
To shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
11.3:
When the foundations are destroyed, 
What shall the righteous do?
11.4:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is in His qodesh Hĕyḵal, 
The throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is in the shamayim. 
His eyes see, His eyelids examine the sons of men.
11.5:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 tries the righteous, 
But His being shall hate the wicked and the one who loves violence.
11.6:
Upon the wicked He rains snares, fire and sulphur 
And a scorching wind 
Are the portion of their cup.

110.1:
A psalm, of Dawiḏ. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 said to Aḏoni, 
“Sit at My right hand, 
Until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
110.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sends Your mighty sceptre out of Tsiyon. 
Rule in the midst of Your enemies!
110.3:
Your people volunteer in the day of Your might, 
In the splendors of qodeshah! 
From the womb, from the morning, 
You have the dew of Your youth!
110.4:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has sworn and does not relent, 
“You are a Kohĕn forever 
According to the order of Malkitseḏeq.”
110.5:
Aḏonai at Your right hand 
Shall smite melaḵim in the day of His wrath.
110.6:
He judges among the nations, 
He shall fill with dead bodies, 
He shall crush the Head over the mighty earth!
110.7:
He drinks of the stream by the wayside, 
Therefore He lifts up the head!

111.1:
א,𐤀 Hallelu-Yah! 
I thank 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with all my heart, 
ב,𐤁 In the company of the straight, and of the congregation.
111.2:
ג ,𐤂 Great are the works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
ד,𐤃 Searched for by all who delight in them.
111.3:
ה,𐤄 Splendor and greatness are His work, 
ו,𐤅 And His righteousness stands forever.
111.4:
ז,𐤆 He has made His wonders to be remembered;  
ח,𐤇 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shows favor and is compassionate.
111.5:
ט,𐤈 He has given food to those who revere Him;
י,𐤉 He remembers His Covenant forever.
111.6:
כ,𐤊 He has shown His people the power of His works, 
ל,𐤋 To give to them the inheritance of the gentiles.
111.7:
מ,𐤌 The works of His hands are truth and Right-Ruling,
נ,𐤍 All His Orders are trustworthy,
111.8:
ס,𐤎 They are upheld forever and ever,
ע,𐤏 Performed in truth and straightness.
111.9:
פ,𐤐 He sent redemption to His people, 
צ,𐤑 He has commanded His Covenant forever. 
ק,𐤒 Qodesh and awesome is His Name.
111.10:
ר,𐤓 The reverence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is the beginning of wisdom,
ש,𐤔 All those doing them have a good understanding.
ת,𐤕 His praise is standing forever.

112.1:
Hallelu-Yah!
א,𐤀 Ashrĕ is the man who reveres 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
ב,𐤁 Who has greatly delighted in His Commands.
112.2:
ג,𐤂 Mighty in the earth shall be his seed,
ד,𐤃 The generation of the straight ones shall receive beraḵah.
112.3:
ה,𐤄 Wealth and riches are in his house,
ו,𐤅 And his righteousness is standing forever.
112.4:
ז,𐤆 Light has risen in the darkness to the straight ones,
ח,𐤇 Showing favor, compassionate, and righteous.
112.5:
ט,𐤈 Good is a man showing favor and lending,
י,𐤉 He sustains his matters in right- ruling.
112.6:
כ,𐤊 For he is never shaken;
ל,𐤋 The righteous is remembered forever.
112.7:
מ,𐤌 He is not afraid of an evil report.
נ,𐤍 His heart is steadfast, trusting in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
112.8:
ס,𐤎 His heart is upheld, he is not afraid,
ע,𐤏 While he looks on his adversaries.
112.9:
פ,𐤐 He scattered abroad, he gave to the poor,
צ,𐤑 His righteousness is standing forever.
ק,𐤒 His horn is exalted with esteem.

113.1:
Hallelu-Yah! 
Praise, O servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Praise the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!
113.2:
Baruḵ be the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Now and forever!
113.3:
From the rising of the sun to its going down, 
The Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is praised.
113.4:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is high above all nations, 
His esteem above the shamayim.
113.5:
Who is like 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim, 
Who is enthroned on high?
113.6: He looks down on the shamayim and in the earth;
113.7:
He raises the poor out of the dust, 
Lifts the needy from a dunghill,
113.8:
To make him sit with the nobles, 
With the nobles of His people,
113.9:
Causing the barren to dwell in a house, 
A rejoicing mother of children. 
Hallelu-Yah!

114.1:
When Yisra’ĕl went out of Mitsrayim, 
The house of Ya’aqoḇ from a people of strange language,
114.2:
Yahuḏah became His qodeshah, 
And Yisra’ĕl His rule.
114.3:
The sea saw it and fled; 
The Yardĕn turned back.
114.4:
The mountains skipped like rams, 
The little hills like lambs.
114.5:
Why was it, O sea, that you fled? 
O Yardĕn, that you turned back?
114.6:
O mountains, that you skipped like rams? 
O little hills, like lambs?
114.7:
Tremble, O earth, from the face of the Aḏon, 
From the face of the Eloah of Ya’aqoḇ,
114.8:
Who turned the rock into a pool of water, 
The flint into a fountain of water.

115.1:
Not to us, 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, not to us, 
But to Your Name give esteem, 
For Your kindness, For your truth.
115.2:
Why should the gentiles say, 
“Where now is their Elohim?”
115.3:
But our Elohim is in the shamayim; 
Whatever pleased Him, He has done.
115.4:
Their idols are silver and gold, 
The work of men’s hands.
115.5:
They have mouths, but they do not speak; 
They have eyes, but they do not see;
115.6:
They have ears, but they do not hear; 
They have noses, but they do not smell;
115.8:
The ones who make them, shall become like them - 
All who trust in them.
115.9:
O Yisra’ĕl, trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
He is their help and their shield.
115.10:
O house of Aharon, trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
He is their help and their shield.
115.11:
You who revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
He is their help and their shield.
115.13:
He baraḵ those who revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
The small and the great.
115.14:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 give you increase more and more, 
You and your children.
115.15:
You are beruḵim by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Who made the shamayim and earth.
115.16:
The shamayim are the shamayim of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
But He has given the earth to the children of men.
115.17:
The dead do not Hallelu-Yah, 
Nor any going down to silence.
115.18:
But we, we baraḵ Yah, 
Now and forever. 
Hallelu-Yah!

116.1: I love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, because He has heard my voice, my pleas.
116.2:
Because He has inclined His ear to me, 
And I shall call throughout my days.
116.4:
Then I called upon the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I pray to You, deliver my being!”
116.5:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shows favor and is righteous; 
And our Elohim is compassionate.
116.6:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 guards the simple; 
I was brought low, but He saved me.
116.7:
Return to your rest, O my being, 
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has treated you well.
116.8:
For You have delivered my being from death, 
My eyes from tears, 
My feet from falling.
116.9: I shall walk before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in the land of the living.
116.10:
I have believed, for I speak; 
I have been greatly afflicted.
116.11: I said in my haste, “All men are liars.”
116.12:
What shall I return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? 
All His bounties are upon me.
116.13:
I lift up the cup of deliverance, 
And call upon the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
116.14:
I pay my vows to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Now in the presence of all His people.
116.15:
Precious in the eyes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
Is the death of His kind ones.
116.17:
I bring You a slaughtering of thanksgiving, 
And call upon the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
116.18:
I pay my vows to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
In the presence of all His people,
116.19:
In the courts of the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
In your midst, O Yerushalayim. 
Hallelu-Yah!

117.1:
Hallelu-𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, all you nations! 
Extol Him, all you peoples!
117.2:
For His kindness is mighty over us, 
And the truth of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is everlasting. 
Hallelu-Yah!

118.1:
Oh, give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for He is good! 
Because His kindness is everlasting.
118.2:
Let Yisra’ĕl now say, 
“His kindness is everlasting.”
118.3:
Let the house of Aharon now say, 
“His kindness is everlasting.”
118.4:
Let those who revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 now say, 
“His kindness is everlasting.”
118.5:
I called on Yah in distress; 
Yah answered me in a broad place.
118.6:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is on my side; 
I do not fear what man does to me!
118.7:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is for me among those helping me; 
Therefore I look on those hating me.
118.8:
It is better to take refuge in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Than to trust in man.
118.9:
It is better to take refuge in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Than to trust in princes.
118.10:
All the gentiles surrounded me, 
In the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 I shall cut them off.
118.13:
Pushing, pushing me to fall, 
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 helped me.
118.14:
Yah is my strength and song, 
And He has become my deliverance.
118.16:
The right hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is exalted, 
The right hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 acts mightily.
118.17:
Let me not die, but live, 
And declare the works of Yah.
118.18:
Yah has punished me severely, 
But did not give me over to death.
118.19:
Open to me the gates of righteousness; 
I enter through them, I thank Yah.
118.20:
This is the gate of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
The righteous enter through it.
118.21:
I thank You, 
For You have answered me, 
And have become my deliverance.
118.22:
The Stone which the builders rejected 
Has become the chief Corner-Stone.
118.23:
This was from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
It is marvelous in our eyes.
118.24:
This is the day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has made, 
Let us rejoice and be glad in it.
118.25:
I pray, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, please save; 
I pray, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, please send prosperity.
118.26:
Baruḵ is He who is coming in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
We shall baraḵ you from the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
118.28:
You are my Ĕl, and I praise You; 
You are my Elohim, I exalt You.
118.29:
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for He is good! 
For His kindness is everlasting.

119.1:
א,𐤀 Ashrĕ are the perfect in the Way, 
Who walk in the Torah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!
119.2:
Ashrĕ are those who observe His Witnesses, 
Who seek Him with all the heart!
119.3:
Even they shall do no unrighteousness; 
They shall walk in His Ways.
119.4:
You have commanded us 
To guard Your Orders diligently.
119.5:
Oh, that my ways were established 
To guard Your Laws!
119.6:
Then I would not be ashamed, 
When I look into all Your Commands.
119.7:
I thank You with uprightness of heart, 
When I learn the Right-Rulings of Your righteousness.
119.8:
I guard Your Laws; 
Oh, do not leave me entirely!
119.9:
ב,𐤁 How would a young man cleanse his path? 
By guarding it according to Your Word.
119.10:
I have sought You with all my heart; 
Let me not stray from Your Commands!
119.11:
I have treasured up Your Word in my heart, 
That I might not sin against You.
119.12:
Baruḵ are You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
Teach me Your Laws.
119.13:
With my lips I have recounted 
All the Right-Rulings of Your mouth.
119.14:
I have rejoiced in the Way of Your Witnesses, 
As over all riches.
119.15:
I meditate on Your Orders, 
And regard Your Ways.
119.16:
I delight myself in Your Laws; 
I do not forget Your Word.
119.17:
ג ,𐤂 Do good to Your servant, 
Let me live and I guard Your Word.
119.18:
Open my eyes, that I might see 
Wonders from Your Torah.
119.19:
I am a sojourner in the earth; 
Do not hide Your Commands from me.
119.20:
My being is crushed with longing 
For Your Right-Rulings at all times.
119.21:
You rebuked the proud, cursed ones, 
Who are straying from Your Commands.
119.22:
Remove from me reproach and scorn, 
For I have observed Your Witnesses.
119.23:
Though princes sat, speaking against me, 
Your servant meditates on Your Laws.
119.24:
Your Witnesses also are my delight, 
My counsellors.
119.25:
ד,𐤃 My being has been clinging to the dust; 
Revive me according to Your Word.
119.26:
I have recounted my ways and You answered me; 
Teach me Your Laws.
119.27:
Make me understand the way of Your Orders; 
That I might meditate on Your wonders.
119.28:
My being has wept from grief; 
Strengthen me according to Your Word.
119.29:
Remove from me the way of falsehood, 
And favor me with Your Torah.
119.30:
I have chosen the Way of truth; 
Your Right-Rulings I have held level.
119.31:
I have clung to Your Witnesses; 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do not put me to shame!
119.32:
I run the Way of Your Commands, 
For You enlarge my heart.
119.33:
ה,𐤄 Teach me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, the Way of Your Laws, 
And I observe it to the end.
119.34:
Make me understand, that I might observe Your Torah, 
And guard it with all my heart.
119.35:
Make me walk in the path of Your Commands, 
For I have delighted in it.
119.36:
Incline my heart to Your Witnesses, 
And not to greedy gain.
119.37:
Turn away my eyes from looking at falsehood, 
And revive me in Your Way.
119.38:
Establish Your Word to Your servant, 
Which leads to the reverence of You.
119.39:
Turn away my reproach which I dread, 
For Your Right-Rulings are good.
119.40:
See, I have longed for Your Orders; 
Revive me in Your righteousness.
119.41:
ו,𐤅 And let Your kindnesses come to me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Your deliverance, according to Your Word,
119.42:
So that I answer my reprover, 
For I have trusted in Your Word.
119.44:
That I might guard Your Torah continually, 
Forever and ever;
119.45:
That I might walk in a broad place, 
For I have sought Your Orders;
119.46:
That I might speak of Your Witnesses before melaḵim, 
And not be ashamed;
119.47:
That I might delight myself in Your Commands, 
Which I have loved;
119.49:
ז,𐤆 Remember the Word to Your servant, 
On which You have caused me to wait.
119.50:
This is my comfort in my affliction, 
For Your Word has given me ḥai.
119.51:
The proud have utterly scorned me, 
I did not turn aside from Your Torah.
119.52:
I remembered Your Right-Rulings of old, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And I comfort myself.
119.53:
Rage has seized me because of the wicked 
Who forsake Your Torah.
119.54:
Your Laws have been my songs 
In the place of my sojournings.
119.55:
I have remembered Your Name in the night, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And I guard Your Torah.
119.56:
This has become mine, 
Because I have observed Your Orders.
119.57:
ח,𐤇 You are my portion, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
I have promised to guard Your Words.
119.58:
I have sought Your face with all my heart; 
Show me favor according to Your Word.
119.59:
I have thought upon my ways, 
And turned my feet to Your Witnesses.
119.60:
I have hurried, and did not delay 
To guard Your Commands.
119.61:
The cords of the wicked have surrounded me, 
Your Torah I have not forgotten.
119.62:
At midnight I rise to give thanks to You, 
For Your righteous Right-Rulings.
119.63:
I am a companion of all who revere You, 
And of those guarding Your Orders.
119.64:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Your kindness has filled the earth; 
Teach me Your Laws.
119.65:
ט,𐤈 You have done good to Your servant, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
According to Your Word.
119.66:
Teach me good sense and knowledge, 
For I have trusted in Your Commands.
119.67:
Before I was afflicted, I myself was going astray, 
But now I have guarded Your Word.
119.68:
You are good, and do good; 
Teach me Your Laws.
119.69:
The proud have forged a lie against me, 
With all heart I observe Your Orders.
119.71:
It was good for me that I was afflicted, 
That I might learn Your Laws.
119.72:
The Torah of Your mouth is better to me 
Than thousands of gold and silver pieces.
119.73:
י,𐤉 Your hands have made me and formed me; 
Make me understand, that I might learn Your Commands.
119.74:
Those who revere You, see me and rejoice, 
For I have waited for Your Word.
119.75:
I know, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
That Your Right-Rulings are righteous, 
And in trustworthiness You have afflicted me.
119.76:
Please let Your kindness be for my comfort, 
According to Your Word to Your servant.
119.77:
Let Your compassions come to me, 
That I might live, 
For Your Torah is my delight.
119.79:
Let those who revere You turn to me, 
And those who know Your Witnesses.
119.80:
Let my heart be perfect in Your Laws, 
So that I am not put to shame.
119.81:
כ,𐤊 For Your deliverance my being has pined away, 
For I have waited for Your Word.
119.82:
My eyes have pined away for Your Word, 
Saying, “When would it comfort me?”
119.83:
For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, 
Your Laws I have not forgotten.
119.84:
How many are the days of Your servant? 
When do You execute Right-Ruling 
On those who persecute me?
119.85:
The proud have dug pits for me, 
Which is not according to Your Torah.
119.87:
They almost made an end of me on earth, 
But I, I did not forsake Your Orders.
119.88:
Revive me according to Your kindness, 
That I might guard the Witness of Your mouth.
119.89: ל,𐤋 Forever, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Your Word stands firm in the shamayim.
119.90:
Your Trustworthiness is to all generations; 
You established the earth, and it stands.
119.91:
According to Your Right-Rulings 
They have stood to this day, 
For all are Your servants.
119.92:
If Your Torah had not been my delight, 
I would have perished in my affliction.
119.93:
Let me never forget Your Orders, 
For by them You have given me ḥai.
119.94:
I am Yours, save me; 
For I have sought Your Orders.
119.95:
The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; 
I understand Your Witnesses.
119.96:
I have seen an end of all perfection; 
Your Command is exceedingly broad.
119.97:
מ,𐤌 O how I love Your Torah! 
It is my study all day long.
119.98:
Your Commands make me wiser than my enemies; 
For it is ever before me.
119.99:
I have more understanding than all my teachers, 
For Your Witnesses are my study.
119.100:
I understand more than the aged, 
For I have observed Your Orders.
119.101:
I have restrained my feet from every evil way, 
That I might guard Your Word.
119.102:
I have not turned aside from Your Right-Rulings, 
For You Yourself have taught me.
119.103:
How sweet to my taste has Your Word been, 
More than honey to my mouth!
119.104:
From Your Orders I get understanding; 
Therefore I have hated every false way.
119.105:
נ,𐤍 Your Word is a lamp to my feet 
And a light to my path.
119.106:
I have sworn, and I confirm, 
To guard Your righteous Right- Rulings.
119.107:
I have been afflicted very much; 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, revive me according to Your Word.
119.108:
Please accept the voluntary offerings of my mouth, 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, And teach me Your Right- Rulings.
119.109:
My life is in my hand continually, 
And Your Torah I have not forgotten.
119.110:
The wicked have laid a snare for me, 
But I have not strayed from Your Orders.
119.111:
Your Witnesses are my inheritance forever, 
For they are the joy of my heart.
119.112:
I have inclined my heart to do Your Laws 
Forever, to the end.
119.113:
ס,𐤎 I have hated doubting thoughts, 
But I have loved Your Torah.
119.114:
You are my hiding place and my shield; 
I have waited for Your Word.
119.115:
Turn away from me, you evil-doers, 
For I observe the Commands of my Elohim!
119.116:
Support me according to Your Word, 
That I might live; 
And do not put me to shame 
Because of my expectation.
119.117:
Sustain me, that I might be saved, 
And always look to Your Laws.
119.118:
You have made light of all those 
Who stray from Your Laws, 
For falsehood is their deceit.
119.120:
My flesh has trembled for reverence of You, 
And I am in awe of Your Right- Rulings.
119.121:
ע,𐤏 I have done Right-Ruling and righteousness; 
Leave me not to my oppressors.
119.122:
Guarantee Your servant’s well-being; 
Let not the proud oppress me.
119.123:
My eyes have pined away for Your deliverance, 
And for the Word of Your righteousness.
119.124:
Do with Your servant according to Your kindness, 
And teach me Your Laws.
119.125:
I am Your servant - make me understand, 
That I might know Your Witnesses.
119.126:
It is time for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 to act! 
For they have broken Your Torah.
119.127:
Therefore I have loved Your Commands 
More than gold, even fine gold!
119.128:
Therefore all Orders I count as right; 
I have hated every false way.
119.129:
פ,𐤐 Your Witnesses are wonders; 
So my being observes them.
119.130:
The opening up of Your Words gives light, 
Giving understanding to the simple.
119.131:
I have opened my mouth and panted, 
For I have longed for Your Commands.
119.132:
Turn to me and show me favor, 
According to Your Right-Ruling, toward those who love Your Name.
119.133:
Establish my footsteps by Your Word, 
And let no wickedness have rule over me.
119.134:
Redeem me from the oppression of man, 
That I might guard Your Orders.
119.135:
Make Your face shine upon Your servant, 
And teach me Your Laws.
119.136:
Streams of water have run down from my eyes, 
Because they did not guard Your Torah.
119.137:
צ,𐤑 Righteous are You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And Your Right-Rulings are straight.
119.138:
You have commanded Your Witnesses 
In righteousness and much truth.
119.139:
My ardor has consumed me, 
For my adversaries have forgotten Your Words.
119.140:
Your Word is exceedingly refined; 
And Your servant has loved it
119.141:
I am small and despised; 
I have not forgotten Your Orders.
119.142:
Your righteousness is righteousness forever, 
And Your Torah is truth.
119.143:
Distress and anguish have found me; 
Your Commands are my delight.
119.144:
The righteousness of Your Witnesses is forever; 
Make me understand, that I might live.
119.146:
I have called upon You; 
Save me, that I might guard Your Witnesses.
119.147:
I rise before dawn, and cry for help; 
I have waited for Your Word.
119.148:
My eyes have gone before the night watches, 
To study Your Word.
119.149:
Hear my voice according to Your kindness; 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, revive me according to Your Right-Ruling.
119.150:
Those who pursue mischief have drawn near; 
They have been far from Your Torah.
119.151:
You are near, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And all Your Commands are truth.
119.152:
Of old I have known Your Witnesses, 
That You have founded them forever.
119.153:
ר,𐤓 See my affliction and deliver me, 
For I have not forgotten Your Torah.
119.154:
Plead my cause and redeem me; 
Revive me according to Your Word.
119.155:
Deliverance is far from the wicked, 
For they have not sought Your Laws.
119.156:
Your compassions are many, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Revive me according to Your Right- Rulings.
119.157:
My persecutors and adversaries are many; 
I have not turned aside from Your Witnesses.
119.158:
I saw traitors and was loathed, 
Because they did not guard Your Word.
119.159:
See how I have loved Your Orders, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, revive me according to Your kindness.
119.160:
The sum of Your Word is truth, 
And all Your righteous Right-Rulings are forever.
119.161:
שׁ,𐤔 Rulers have persecuted me without a cause, 
But at Your Word my heart stood in awe.
119.162:
I rejoice at Your Word 
As one who finds great treasure.
119.163:
I have hated falsehood and loathe it, 
Your Torah I have loved.
119.164:
I have praised You seven times a day, 
Because of Your righteous Right- Rulings.
119.165:
Great peace have those loving Your Torah, 
And for them there is no stumbling- block.
119.166:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I have waited for Your deliverance, 
And I have done Your Commands.
119.167:
My being has guarded Your Witnesses, 
And I love them exceedingly.
119.168:
I have guarded Your Orders and Your Witnesses, 
For all my ways are before You.
119.169:
ת,𐤕 My cry comes before You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Make me understand according to Your Word.
119.170:
Let my prayer come before You; 
Deliver me according to Your Word.
119.171:
My lips pour forth praise, 
For You teach me Your Laws.
119.172:
My tongue sings of Your Word, 
For all Your Commands are righteousness.
119.173:
Your hand is a help to me, 
For I have chosen Your Orders.
119.174:
I have longed for Your deliverance, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And Your Torah is my delight.
119.175:
My being lives, and it praises You; 
And Your Right-Rulings help me.

12.1:
Save, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for the kind one is no more! 
For the trustworthy have ceased from among the sons of men.
12.2:
They speak falsehood with each other; 
Flattering lips, and a double heart they speak.
12.3:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 cuts off all flattering lips, 
A tongue that speaks swelling words,
12.5:
“Because of the oppression of the poor, because of the sighing of the needy, 
I now arise,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
“I place in safety - he pants for it.”
12.6:
The Words of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 are clean words, 
Silver tried in a furnace of earth, 
Refined seven times.
12.7:
You guard them, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
You preserve them, from this generation forever.
12.8:
The wicked walk around on every side, 
When worthlessness is exalted among the sons of men.

120.1:
A song of degrees. In my distress I cried to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And He answered me.
120.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, deliver my being from false lips, 
From a treacherous tongue.
120.3:
What would one give to you, 
Or what would one do to you, 
O treacherous tongue?
120.4:
Sharp arrows of a mighty man, 
With coals of the broom-wood!
120.5:
Woe to me for I have sojourned in Mesheḵ, 
I have dwelt among the tents of Qĕḏar!
120.6:
My being has dwelt too long 
With him who hates peace.
120.7:
I am peace; 
But when I speak, they are for fighting.

121.1:
A song of degrees. I lift up my eyes to the hills; 
Where does my help come from?
121.2:
My help comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Maker of the shamayim and earth.
121.3:
He does not allow your foot to be moved; 
He who watches over you does not slumber.
121.4:
See, He who is guarding Yisra’ĕl 
Neither slumbers nor sleeps.
121.5:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is your guard; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is your shade at your right hand.
121.6:
The sun does not strike you by day, 
Nor the moon by night.
121.7:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 guards you from all evil; 
He guards your being.
121.8:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 guards your going out and your coming in 
Now and forever.

122.1:
A song of degrees. Of Dawiḏ. I was glad when they said to me, 
“Let us go into the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.”
122.2:
Our feet have been standing 
Within your gates, O Yerushalayim!
122.3:
Yerushalayim is built 
As a city that is bound together,
122.4:
Where the tribes have come up, 
The tribes of Yah, 
A witness to Yisra’ĕl, 
To give thanks to the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
122.5:
For there the thrones of right- ruling were appointed, 
The thrones of the house of Dawiḏ.
122.6:
Pray for the peace of Yerushalayim, 
Let those who love You be at rest.
122.7:
Peace be within your walls, 
Rest in your citadels.
122.8:
For the sake of my brothers and companions, 
I say, “Peace be within you.”
122.9:
For the sake of the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim 
I seek your good.

123.1:
A song of degrees. I shall lift up my eyes 
Unto You who dwell in the shamayim.
123.2:
See, as the eyes of servants 
Are toward the hand of their masters, 
As the eyes of a female servant 
Are toward the hand of her mistress, 
So are our eyes toward 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim, 
Until He shows favor to us.
123.3:
Show favor to us, 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, show favor to us! 
For we are exceedingly filled with mockery.
123.4:
Our being is exceedingly filled 
With the scoffing of those who are at ease, 
With the mockery of the proud.

124.1:
A song of degrees. Of Dawiḏ. “If it had not been 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 who was on our side, 
”Let Yisra’ĕl now say;
124.2:
“If it had not been 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 who was on our side, 
When men rose up against us,
124.3:
“Then they would have swallowed us alive, 
In their burning rage against us;
124.4:
“Then the waters would have overwhelmed us, 
The stream would have gone over our being;
124.5:
“Then the proud waters 
Would have gone over our being.”
124.6:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Who did not give us as prey to their teeth.
124.8:
Our help is in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Maker of the shamayim and earth.

125.1:
A song of degrees. Those who trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
Are like Mount Tsiyon - 
It is not shaken, it remains forever.
125.2:
As the mountains surround Yerushalayim, 
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 surrounds His people, 
Now and forever.
125.3:
For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest 
On the land allotted to the righteous, 
Lest the righteous stretch forth their hands to unrighteousness.
125.4:
Do good, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, to those who are good, 
And to those who are upright in their hearts.
125.5:
But those who turn aside to their crooked ways, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall lead them away 
With the workers of wickedness. 
Peace be upon Yisra’ĕl!

126.1:
A song of degrees. When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 turns back the captivity of Tsiyon, 
We shall be like dreamers.
126.2:
Then our mouth shall be filled with laughter, 
And our tongue with singing, 
Then shall they say among the gentiles, 
“𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has done greatness for them.”
126.3:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall do greatness for us, 
We shall be glad.
126.4:
Turn back our captivity, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Like the streams in the South.
126.5: Those sowing in tears, shall reap with songs of joy.
126.6:
He who goes on and weeps, 
Bearing seed for sowing, 
Shall indeed come in with rejoicing, 
Bearing his sheaves.

127.1:
A song of degrees. To Shelomoh. If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 does not build the house, 
Its builders have labored in vain. 
If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 does not guard the city, 
The watchman has stayed awake in vain.
127.3:
Look, children are an inheritance from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
The fruit of the womb is the reward.
127.4:
As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, 
So are the children of one’s youth.
127.5:
Ashrĕ is the man 
Who has filled his quiver with them. 
They are not ashamed, 
When they speak with their enemies in the gate.

128.1:
A song of degrees. Ashrĕ are all who revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Who walk in His Ways.
128.2:
You shall eat the labor of your hands. 
Be ashrĕ, and let it be well with you.
128.3:
Let your wife be 
As a fruit-bearing vine within your house, 
Your sons like olive plants all around your table.
128.4:
Look, so shall the man receive beraḵah 
Who reveres 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
128.5:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall baraḵ you out of Tsiyon, 
And let you see the good of Yerushalayim 
All the days of your life,
128.6:
And let you see your children’s children! 
Peace be upon Yisra’ĕl!

129.1:
A song of degrees. “Often they have distressed me from my youth.” 
Let Yisra’ĕl now say,
129.2:
“Often they have distressed me from my youth, 
But they have not overcome me.
129.3:
“The ploughers ploughed on my back 
They made their furrows long.”
129.4:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is righteous; 
He has cut the cords of the wicked in two.
129.5:
Let all those who hate Tsiyon 
Be put to shame and turned back.
129.6:
Let them be as the grass on the house-tops, 
Which withers before it grows up,
129.7:
That shall not fill the reaper’s hand, 
Nor the sheaves the binder’s bosom.

13.1:
How long would You forget me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? Forever? 
How long would You hide Your face from me?
13.2:
How long would I take counsel in my being, 
Grief in my heart day by day? 
How long would my enemy be exalted over me?
13.3:
Look! Answer me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim; 
Enlighten my eyes, Lest I sleep in death;
13.4:
Lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him,” 
My adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
13.5:
But I have trusted in Your kindness; 
My heart rejoices in Your deliverance.
13.6:
I sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Because He has been good to me.

130.1: A song of degrees. Out of the depths I have cried to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
130.2:
O Aḏonai, hear my voice! 
Let Your ears be attentive 
To the voice of my prayers.
130.3:
O Yah, if You should watch wickednesses, 
O Aḏonai, who would stand?
130.4:
But with You there is forgiveness, 
That You might be revered.
130.5:
I looked to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, My being has looked, 
And for His Word I have waited.
130.6:
My being, for Aḏonai 
More than those watching for morning, watching for morning.
130.8:
For He shall redeem Yisra’ĕl 
From all his wickednesses.

131.1:
A song of degrees. Of Dawiḏ. O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, my heart has not been proud, 
Nor have my eyes been haughty. 
Neither have I concerned myself with great matters, 
Nor with those too wondrous for me.
131.2:
Have I not calmed, and kept my being silent, 
Like one weaned by its mother? 
My being is like one weaned.
131.3:
O Yisra’ĕl, wait for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Now and forever.

132.1:
A song of degrees. O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, remember Dawiḏ, 
All his afflictions;
132.2:
How he swore to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Vowed to the Mighty One of Ya’aqoḇ:
132.3:
“Not to enter into my dwelling-house, 
Not to get into my bed,
132.4:
“Not to give sleep to my eyes, 
Or slumber to my eyelids,
132.5:
“Until I find a place for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
A Mishkan for the Mighty One of Ya’aqoḇ.”
132.6:
See, we heard of it in Ephrathah; 
We found it in the fields of the forest.
132.7:
Let us go into His Mishkanoth; 
Let us bow ourselves at His footstool.
132.8:
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, to Your place of rest, 
You and the ark of Your strength.
132.9:
Let Your kohenim put on righteousness, 
And Your kind ones shout for joy.
132.10:
For the sake of Your servant Dawiḏ, 
Do not turn away the face of Your Anointed One.
132.12:
“If your sons guard My Covenant 
And My Witnesses that I teach them, 
Their sons shall sit upon your throne forever.”
132.13:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has chosen Tsiyon; 
He has desired it for His dwelling:
132.14:
“This is My place of rest forever; 
Here I dwell, for I have desired it.
132.15:
“I greatly baraḵ her provision, 
I satisfy her poor with bread.
132.16:
“And I put deliverance on her kohenim, 
And her kind ones sing for joy.
132.17:
“There I make the horn of Dawiḏ grow; 
I shall prepare a lamp for My Anointed One.
132.18:
“I put shame on His enemies, 
While on Him His diadem shall shine.”

133.1: A song of degrees. Of Dawiḏ. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity
133.2:
Like the precious oil on the head, 
Running down on the beard, 
The beard of Aharon, 
Running down on the collar of his robes -
133.3:
Like the dew of Ḥermon, 
That comes down on the mountains of Tsiyon. 
For there 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 commanded the beraḵah, 
Ḥai forever!

134.1:
A song of degrees. Come, baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
All you servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Who are standing in the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 by night!
134.2:
Lift up your hands in the qodesh place, 
And baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
134.3:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Maker of the shamayim and earth, 
Baraḵ you from Tsiyon!

135.1:
Hallelu-Yah! Praise the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Praise, you servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
135.2:
Who are standing in the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
In the courts of the House of our Elohim,
135.3:
Hallelu-Yah, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is good; 
Sing praises to His Name, for it is pleasant.
135.4:
For Yah has chosen Ya’aqoḇ for Himself, 
Yisra’ĕl for His treasured possession.
135.5:
For I know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is great, 
And our Aḏon is above all mighty ones.
135.6:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has done whatever pleased Him, 
In the shamayim and in earth, 
In the seas and in all the depths,
135.8:
Who smote the first-born of Mitsrayim, 
From man to beast.
135.10:
Who smote many nations, 
And slew mighty melaḵim,
135.11:
Even Siḥon meleḵ of the Amorites, 
And Oḡ meleḵ of Bashan, 
And all the reigns of Kena’an.
135.12:
And He gave their land as an inheritance, 
An inheritance to Yisra’ĕl His people.
135.13:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Your Name is forever, 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Your remembrance to all generations,
135.14:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 rightly rules His people, 
And has compassion on His servants.
135.15:
The idols of the gentiles are silver and gold, 
The work of men’s hands.
135.16:
They have mouths, but they do not speak; 
They have eyes, but they do not see;
135.17:
They have ears, but they do not hear; 
Also there is no breath in their mouth.
135.18:
Those making them become like them, 
Everyone who is trusting in them.
135.19:
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O house of Yisra’ĕl! 
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O house of Aharon!
135.20:
Baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O house of Lĕwi! 
You who revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!
135.21:
Baruḵ from Tsiyon, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 be, 
Who dwells in Yerushalayim! 
Hallelu-Yah.

136.1:
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for He is good! 
For His kindness is everlasting.
136.2:
Give thanks to the Elohim of mighty ones! 
For His kindness is everlasting.
136.3:
Give thanks to the Aḏon of masters! 
For His kindness is everlasting:
136.4:
To Him who alone does great wonders, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.5:
To Him who by wisdom made the shamayim, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.6:
To Him who spread the earth on the waters, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.7:
To Him who made great lights, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.8:
The sun to rule by day, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.9:
The moon and stars to rule by night, 
For His kindness is everlasting.
136.10:
To Him who smote Mitsrayim in their first-born, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.11:
And brought out Yisra’ĕl from their midst, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.12:
With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.13:
To Him who split apart the Sea of Reeds, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.14:
And made Yisra’ĕl pass through the midst of it, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.15:
But shook off Pharaoh and his army in the Sea of Reeds, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.16:
To Him who led His people through the wilderness, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.17:
To Him who smote great melaḵim, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.18:
And slew mighty melaḵim, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.19:
Even Siḥon meleḵ of the Amorites, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.20:
And Oḡ meleḵ of Bashan, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.21:
And gave their land as an inheritance, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.22:
An inheritance to Yisra’ĕl His servant, 
For His kindness is everlasting.
136.23:
Who remembered us in our humiliation, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.24:
And rescued us from our adversaries, 
For His kindness is everlasting;
136.25:
Who gives food to all flesh, 
For His kindness is everlasting.
136.26:
Give thanks to the Ĕl of the shamayim! 
For His kindness is everlasting.

137.1:
By the rivers of Baḇel, 
There we sat down and we wept 
As we remembered Tsiyon.
137.2:
We hung our lyres 
Upon the willows in the midst of it.
137.3:
For there our captors 
Asked us for the words of a song, 
And our plunderers for rejoicing, 
“Sing to us a song of Tsiyon!”
137.4:
How could we sing the song of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
On foreign land?
137.5:
If I forget you, O Yerushalayim, 
Let my right hand forget.
137.6:
Let my tongue cling to my palate, 
If I do not remember you, 
If I do not exalt Yerushalayim 
Above my chief joy.
137.7:
Remember, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, against the sons of Eḏom; 
The day of Yerushalayim, 
Who said, “Lay it bare, lay it bare, 
To its foundation!”
137.8:
O daughter of Baḇel, who are to be destroyed, 
Ashrĕ is he who repays you your deed, 
What you did to us!
137.9:
Ashrĕ is he who shall take 
And dash your little ones against the rock.

138.1:
Of Dawiḏ. I will praise You with all my heart; 
Before Elohim, I sing Your praises.
138.3:
On the day I called, You answered me, 
You made me bold with strength in my being.
138.4:
Let all the melaḵim of the earth 
Give thanks to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
When they shall hear the words of Your mouth.
138.5:
And let them sing of the Ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
For great is the esteem of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
138.7:
Though I walk in the midst of distress, 
You revive me; You stretch out Your hand 
Against the wrath of my enemies, 
And Your right hand saves me.
138.8:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 does perfectly for me. 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Your kindness is everlasting. 
Do not forsake the works of Your hands.

139.1:
To the chief singer. A psalm, of Dawiḏ. O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, You have searched me 
And know me.
139.2:
You know my sitting down and my rising up; 
You understand my thought from afar.
139.3:
You spread my path and my lying down, 
And know well all my ways.
139.4:
For there is not a word on my tongue, 
But see, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, You know it all!
139.5:
You have closed me in, behind and before, 
And laid Your hand upon me -
139.6:
Knowledge too wondrous for me, 
It is high, I cannot fathom.
139.7:
Where would I go from Your Ruaḥ? 
Or where would I flee from Your face?
139.8:
If I go up into the shamayim, You are there; 
If I make my bed in the grave, see, You are there.
139.9:
I take the wings of the morning, 
I dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
139.10:
There too, Your hand would lead me, 
And Your right hand hold me.
139.11:
If I say, “Darkness shall cover me,” 
Then night would be light to me;
139.12:
Even darkness is not dark for You, 
But night shines as the day - 
As is darkness, so is light.
139.13:
For You, You possessed my kidneys, 
You have covered me in my mother’s womb.
139.14:
I give thanks to You, 
For I am awesomely and wondrously made! 
Wondrous are Your works, 
And my being knows it well.
139.15:
My bones were not concealed from You, 
When I was shaped in a hidden place, 
Knit together in the depths of the earth.
139.16:
Your eyes saw my unformed body, 
And in Your Book all of them were written, 
The days they were formed, 
While none was among them.
139.17:
And how precious are Your thoughts to me, O Ĕl! 
How great has been the sum of them!
139.19:
Oh, that You would slay the wicked, O Eloah! 
Depart from me therefore, men of bloodshed!
139.20:
They speak against You wickedly. 
Bring Your enemies to naught!
139.21:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do I not hate them, who hate You? 
And do I not loathe those who rise up against You?
139.22:
With a complete hatred I hate them; 
They have become my enemies.
139.23:
Search me, O Ĕl, and know my heart; 
Try me, and know my thoughts;
139.24:
And see if an idolatrous way is in me, 
And lead me in the Way everlasting,

14.1:
To the chief singer. Of Dawiḏ. The fool has said in his heart, 
“There is no Elohim.” 
They have done corruptly, they have done an abominable deed, 
There is no one who does good.
14.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 looked down from the shamayim on the sons of mankind, 
To see if there is a wise one, seeking Elohim.
14.4:
Have all the workers of wickedness no knowledge, 
Who eat up my people as they eat bread, 
And do not call on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄?
14.5:
There they are in great fear, 
For Elohim is with the generation of the righteous.
14.6:
You would put to shame the counsel of the poor, 
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is his refuge.
14.7:
O that the deliverance of Yisra’ĕl would be given out of Tsiyon! 
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 turns back the captivity of His people, 
Let Ya’aqoḇ rejoice, let Yisra’ĕl be glad.

140.1:
Rescue me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, from men of evil; 
Preserve me from men of violence,
140.2:
Who have devised evils in their hearts; 
They stir up conflicts all day long.
140.3:
They sharpen their tongues like a snake; 
The poison of cobras is under their lips. Selah.
140.6:
I said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, “You are my Ĕl; 
Hear the voice of my prayers, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
140.7:
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Aḏonai, my saving strength, 
You have covered my head in the day of battle.
140.8:
“Do not grant the desires of the wicked, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Do not promote his scheme. Selah.
140.9:
“Those who surround me lift up their head; 
The trouble of their lips cover them;
140.11:
“Let not a slanderer be established in the earth; 
Let evil capture the man of violence speedily.”
140.12:
I have known that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 maintains 
The cause of the afflicted, 
The right-ruling of the poor.
140.13:
Only, let the righteous give thanks to Your Name, 
Let the straight ones dwell in Your presence.

141.1:
A psalm, of Dawiḏ. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I have cried out to You; 
Hasten to me! Give ear to my voice when I cry out to You.
141.2:
Let my prayer be prepared before You as incense, 
The lifting up of my hands as the evening offering.
141.3:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, place a guard for my mouth; 
Watch over the door of my lips.
141.4:
Let not my heart be inclined to evil, 
To practice deeds of wickedness 
With men working wickedness, 
And let me not eat of their delicacies.
141.5:
Let the righteous one smite me 
Or reprove me in kindness - 
It is oil on my head. 
Let my head not refuse it. 
My prayer is still against their evil deeds.
141.6:
Their judges have been thrown down 
By the sides of the rock, 
But they have heard my words, 
For they have been pleasant.
141.7:
Our bones are scattered at the mouth of the grave, 
As when one ploughs and breaks up the earth.
141.9:
Guard me from the clutches 
Of the trap they have laid for me, 
And from the snares 
Of the workers of wickedness.
141.10:
Let the wicked fall into their own nets, 
While I pass by.

142.1:
I cry out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with my voice; 
I pray to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with my voice.
142.2:
I pour out my complaint before Him; 
I declare before Him my distress.
142.3:
When my spirit grew faint within me, 
Then You know my path. 
In the way in which I walk 
They have hidden a trap for me.
142.5:
I cried out to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄: 
I said, “You are my refuge, 
My portion in the land of the living.
142.6:
“Listen to my cry, 
For I am brought very low; 
Deliver me from my persecutors, 
For they are too strong for me.
142.7:
“Bring my being out of prison, 
To give thanks to Your Name. 
Let the righteous gather around me, 
Because You deal kindly with me.”

143.1:
A psalm, of Dawiḏ. Hear my prayer, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Give ear to my pleadings. 
In Your trustworthiness, 
Answer me in Your righteousness,
143.2:
And do not enter into right-ruling with Your servant, 
For before You no one living is in the right.
143.4:
Therefore my spirit grew faint within me, 
My heart within me is stunned.
143.6:
I have spread out my hands to You; 
My being is like a thirsty land for You. Selah.
143.7:
Hasten, answer me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
My spirit fails! 
Do not hide Your face from me, 
Lest I be like those going down into the pit.
143.8:
Let me hear Your kindness in the morning, 
For in You I have put my trust; 
Let me know the way in which I should walk, 
For I have lifted up my being to You.
143.9:
Deliver me from my enemies, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
I take refuge in You.
143.10:
Teach me to do Your good pleasure, 
For You are my Elohim. 
Let Your good Ruaḥ lead me 
In the land of straightness.
143.11:
For the sake of Your Name, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 revive me! 
In Your righteousness, 
Bring my being out of distress.
143.12:
And in Your kindness, 
Cut off my enemies. 
And destroy all the adversaries of my life, 
For I am Your servant!

144.2:
My kindness and my stronghold, 
My tower and my deliverer, 
My shield, and in whom I take refuge, 
Who is subduing peoples under me.
144.3:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, what is man, that You should know him? 
Son of man, that You should think of him?
144.4:
Man is like a breath, 
His days like a passing shadow.
144.5:
Stretch Your shamayim, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and come down; 
Touch the mountains that they smoke.
144.6:
Send forth lightning and scatter them, 
Send forth Your arrows and confuse them.
144.8:
Whose mouth has spoken falsehood, 
And whose right hand is a right hand of lies.
144.9:
O Elohim, a new song I sing to You; 
On a harp of ten strings I sing praises to You,
144.10:
Who gives deliverance to melaḵim, 
Who rescues Dawiḏ His servant 
From the evil sword.
144.15:
Ashrĕ are the people who have it so; 
Ashrĕ are the people whose Elohim is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!

145.1:
Tehillah of Dawiḏ. א,𐤀 I exalt You, my Elohim, O Meleḵ; 
And baraḵ Your Name forever and ever.
145.2:
ב,𐤁 All day long I baraḵ You, 
And praise Your Name forever and ever.
145.3:
ג,𐤂 Great is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and greatly to be praised; 
And His greatness is unsearchable.
145.4:
ד,𐤃 Generation after generation praise Your works, 
And they declare Your mighty acts.
145.5:
ה,𐤄 I declare the esteemed splendor of Your excellency, 
And the matters of Your wondrous works.
145.6:
ו,𐤅 And they speak of the might of Your awesome acts, 
And I recount Your greatness.
145.7:
ז,𐤆 They send forth the remembrance of Your great goodness, 
And they sing of Your righteousness.
145.8:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 ח ,𐤇 shows favor and is compassionate, 
Patient and great in kindness.
145.9:
ט,𐤈 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is good to all, 
And He has compassion on all His works.
145.10:
י,𐤉 All Your works give thanks to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And Your kind ones baraḵ You.
145.11:
כ,𐤊 They speak of the esteem of Your Malḵuth, 
And talk of Your might,
145.12:
ל,𐤋 To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, 
And the esteemed splendor of His Malḵuth.
145.13:
מ,𐤌 Your Malḵuth is an everlasting Malḵuth, 
And Your rule is throughout all generations. 
נ,𐤍 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is trustworthy in all His words 
And shows favor in all His deeds.
145.14:
ס,𐤎 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is supporting all who are falling, 
And raising up all who are bowed down.
145.15:
ע,𐤏 The eyes of all look to You expectantly, 
And You are giving them their food in its season,
145.16:
פ,𐤐 Opening Your hand and satisfying 
The desire of all that live.
145.17:
צ,𐤑 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is righteous in all His ways, 
And kind in all His works.
145.18:
ק,𐤒 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is near to all who call upon Him, 
To all who call upon Him in truth.
145.19:
ר,𐤓 He does the desire of those who revere Him; 
And He hears their cry and saves them.
145.20:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 שׁ ,𐤔 preserves all those loving Him, 
But all the wicked He destroys.
145.21:
ת,𐤕 My mouth speaks the praise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And let all flesh baraḵ His qodesh Name, 
Forever and ever.

146.2:
While I live I hallelah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
I sing praises to my Elohim while I exist.
146.3:
Do not put your trust in princes, 
In a son of man, in whom is no deliverance.
146.4:
His spirit goes out, he returns to his earth; 
In that day his plans perish.
146.5:
Ashrĕ is he who has the Ĕl of Ya’aqoḇ for his help, 
Whose expectancy is in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 his Elohim,
146.6:
Maker of the shamayim and earth, 
The sea and all that is in them, 
Who is guarding truth forever,
146.7:
Doing right-ruling for the oppressed, 
Giving bread to the hungry. 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 releases those who are bound,
146.8:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 opens the blind, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 raises those who are bowed down, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 loves the righteous.
146.9:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 guards the strangers, 
He lifts up the fatherless and widow, 
But the way of the wicked He turns upside down.
146.10:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 reigns forever, O Tsiyon, 
Your Elohim to all generations. 
Hallelu-Yah!

147.1:
Hallelu-Yah! 
For it is good to sing praises to our Elohim. 
For it is pleasant - praise is fitting.
147.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 builds up Yerushalayim, 
He gathers the outcasts of Yisra’ĕl -
147.3:
Heals the broken-hearted 
And binds up their wounds.
147.4:
Appoints the number of the stars, 
He gives names to all of them.
147.5:
Great is our Aḏon and mighty power, 
There is no limit to His understanding.
147.6:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 lifts up the meek ones; 
He throws the wicked down to the ground.
147.7:
Respond to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with thanksgiving; 
Sing praises on a lyre to our Elohim,
147.8:
Who covers the shamayim with clouds, 
Who prepares rain for the earth, 
Who makes grass to sprout on the mountains,
147.9:
Giving to the beast its food, 
To the young ravens that cry.
147.10:
He does not delight in the strength of the horse, 
He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
147.11:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 takes pleasure in those who revere Him, 
In those who wait for His kindness.
147.12:
Extol 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O Yerushalayim! 
Praise your Elohim, O Tsiyon!
147.13:
For He has strengthened the bars of your gates, 
He has baraḵ your children in your midst,
147.14:
Who makes peace in your borders, 
He satisfies you with the finest wheat;
147.15:
Who sends out His Command to the earth, 
His word runs very speedily;
147.16:
Who gives snow like wool, 
He scatters the frost like ashes;
147.17:
Throwing out His hail like pieces; 
Who stands before His cold?
147.18:
He sends out His word and melts them, 
He causes His wind to blow - the waters flow;
147.19:
Declaring His Word to Ya’aqoḇ, 
His Laws and His Right-Rulings to Yisra’ĕl.

148.1:
Hallelu-Yah! 
Hallelu-𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 from the shamayim, 
Praise Him in the heights!
148.2:
Praise Him, all His messengers; 
Praise Him, all His hosts!
148.3:
Praise Him, sun and moon; 
Praise Him, all you stars of light!
148.4:
Praise Him, shamayim of shamayim, 
And you waters above the shamayim!
148.5:
Let them praise the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
For He commanded and they were created.
148.6:
And He established them forever and ever, 
He gave a law and they pass not beyond.
148.7:
Hallelu-𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 from the earth, 
You great sea creatures and all the depths,
148.8:
Fire and hail, snow and clouds, 
Stormy wind that does His word,
148.9:
The mountains and all hills, 
Fruit tree and all cedars,
148.10:
Wild beasts and all cattle, 
Creeping creatures and flying birds,
148.11:
Melaḵim of the earth and all peoples, 
Rulers and all judges of the earth,
148.12:
Both young men and maidens, 
Old men and children.
148.13:
Let them praise the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
For His Name alone is exalted, 
His splendor is above the earth and shamayim.
148.14:
He also lifts up the horn of His people, 
The praise of all His kind ones; 
Of the children of Yisra’ĕl, 
A people near to Him. 
Hallelu-Yah!

149.1:
Hallelu-Yah! 
I Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 a new song, 
His praise in an assembly of kind ones.
149.2:
Let Yisra’ĕl rejoice in their Maker; 
Let the children of Tsiyon exult in their Meleḵ.
149.3:
Let them praise His Name in a dance; 
Let them sing praises to Him with the tambourine and lyre.
149.4:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 takes pleasure in His people; 
He embellishes the meek ones with deliverance.
149.5:
Let the kind ones exult in esteem; 
Let them sing aloud on their beds.
149.6:
Let the exaltation of Ĕl be in their mouth, 
And a two-edged sword in their hand,
149.7:
To execute vengeance on the gentiles, 
Punishments on the peoples;
149.8:
To bind their melaḵim with chains, 
And their nobles with iron bands;

15.1:
A psalm of Dawiḏ. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, who sojourns in Your Tent? 
Who dwells in Your qodesh mountain?
15.2:
He who walks blamelessly, 
And does righteousness, 
And speaks the truth in his heart.
15.5:
He has not put out his silver at interest, 
And has not taken a bribe against the innocent. 
He who does these is never moved.

150.1:
Hallelu-Yah! 
Praise Ĕl in His qodeshah 
Praise Him in His mighty expanse!
150.2:
Praise Him for His mighty acts; 
Praise Him according to His excellent greatness!
150.3:
Praise Him with the blowing of the ram’s horn; 
Praise Him with the harp and lyre!
150.4:
Praise Him with tambourine and dance; 
Praise Him with stringed instruments and flutes!
150.5:
Praise Him with sounding cymbals; 
Praise Him with resounding cymbals!
150.6:
Let all that have breath hallĕl Yah. 
Hallelu-Yah!

16.1: A poem of Dawiḏ. Guard me, O Ĕl, for I have taken refuge in You.
16.2:
I have said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
“You are Aḏonai, 
I have no good beside You.”
16.3:
As for the qodeshim who are on the earth, 
They are the excellent ones, in whom is all my delight.
16.5:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is the portion of my inheritance and my cup; 
You uphold my lot.
16.6:
Lines have fallen to me in pleasant places; 
Indeed, a good inheritance is mine.
16.7:
I baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 who has given me counsel; 
My kidneys also instruct me in the nights.
16.8:
I have put 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 always before me; 
Because He is at my right hand I am not shaken.
16.9:
Therefore my heart was glad, and my esteem rejoices; 
My flesh also dwells in safety.
16.10:
For You do not leave my being in the grave, 
Neither let Your Kind One see corruption.

17.1:
A prayer of Dawiḏ. Hear righteousness, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
Listen to my cry; 
Give ear to my prayer, 
From lips without deceit.
17.2:
Let my right-ruling go out from Your presence; 
Let Your eyes see what is straight.
17.4:
As for the deeds of men - 
By the word of Your lips, 
I have kept myself from the paths of the destroyer.
17.5:
My steps have held fast to Your paths, 
My feet have not slipped.
17.6:
I have called upon You, 
For You answer me, O Ĕl; 
Incline Your ear to me, 
Hear my speech.
17.7:
Let Your kindness be distinguished, 
You who save by Your right hand 
Those who take refuge from those who rise up.
17.8:
Guard me as the apple of Your eye. 
Hide me under the shadow of Your wings,
17.9:
From the face of the wicked who ravage me, 
From my deadly enemies who surround me.
17.10:
They are enclosed in their own fat, 
They speak proudly with their mouths,
17.11:
They have now surrounded us in our steps, 
They turn their eyes to stretch over the land,
17.12:
Like a lion who is eager to tear his prey, 
And as a young lion crouching in cover.
17.13:
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Confront him, 
Cause him to bend; 
Deliver my being from the wicked by Your sword,
17.14:
From men by Your hand, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
From men of the world whose portion is in life, 
And You fill their bodies with Your treasure, 
They are satisfied with children, 
And shall leave their riches to their children.
17.15:
As for me, let Me see Your face in righteousness; 
I am satisfied - Your appearance when I awake.

18.1: I love You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, my strength.
18.3:
I call upon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, the One to be praised, 
And I am saved from my enemies.
18.4:
The cords of death surrounded me, 
And the floods of Beliya’al made me afraid.
