18.5:
The cords of the grave were all around me; 
The snares of death were before me.
18.6:
In my distress I called upon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And to my Elohim I cried; 
He heard my voice from His Hĕyḵal, 
And my cry went before Him, into His ears.
18.9:
And He bowed the shamayim and came down, 
And dense cloud was under His feet,
18.10:
And He rode upon a keruḇ, and flew; 
He flew upon the wings of the wind.
18.12:
From the brightness before Him, 
His thick clouds passed, hail and coals of fire.
18.13:
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 thundered in the shamayim, 
And the Most High sent forth His voice, 
Hail and coals of fire.
18.14:
And He sent out His arrows and scattered them, 
And much lightning, and confused them.
18.15:
And the channels of waters were seen, 
And the foundations of the world were uncovered 
At Your rebuke, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
18.16:
He sent from above, He took me; 
He drew me out of many waters.
18.17:
He delivered me from my strong enemy, 
And from those hating me, for they were stronger than I.
18.18:
They confronted me in the day of my calamity, 
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 was my support.
18.19:
And He brought me out into a large place; 
He delivered me for He delighted in my righteousness;
18.20:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 rewarded me according to my righteousness 
According to the cleanness of my hands He repaid me.
18.21:
For I have guarded the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And have not acted wickedly against my Elohim.
18.22:
For all His Right-Rulings are before me, 
And I did not turn from His Laws.
18.23:
And I am perfect before Him, 
And I guard myself from my wickedness.
18.24:
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 repays me according to my righteousness, 
According to the cleanness of my hands before His eyes.
18.25:
With the kind You show Yourself kind; 
With the perfect one You show Yourself perfect;
18.26:
With the clean You show Yourself clean; 
And with the wicked You show Yourself twisted.
18.27:
For You save the afflicted people, 
But bring down those whose eyes are haughty.
18.28:
For You Yourself light my lamp; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim makes my darkness light.
18.29:
For with You I run against a band, 
And with my Elohim I leap over a wall.
18.31:
For who is Eloah, besides 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? 
And who is a rock, except our Elohim?
18.32:
It is Ĕl who girds me with strength, 
And makes my way perfect,
18.33:
Making my feet like the feet of deer, 
And puts me on my high places,
18.34:
Teaching my hands for battle, 
So that my arms shall bend a bow of bronze.
18.36:
You enlarge my step under me; 
And my feet shall not slip.
18.37:
I pursue my enemies and overtake them; 
And do not turn back till they are destroyed.
18.38:
I crush them, and they are unable to rise; 
They fall under my feet.
18.39:
And You gird me with strength for battle; 
Cause my adversaries to bow under me.
18.40:
And You have made my enemies turn their backs, 
As for those hating me, I cut them off.
18.41:
They cry - but no one is there to save, 
To 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 - but He answers them not.
18.42:
And I beat them as dust before the wind; 
I empty them out like dirt in the streets.
18.44:
As soon as they hear of me they obey me; 
The foreigners submit to me.
18.45:
The foreigners fade away, 
And come frightened from their strongholds.
18.46:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 lives! And baruḵ is my Rock! 
And exalted is the Elohim of my deliverance,
18.47:
The Ĕl who avenges me, 
And He humbles the peoples under me;
18.49:
Therefore I give thanks to 
You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, among nations, 
And I sing praise to Your Name,
18.50:
Making great the deliverance of His meleḵ, 
And showing kindness to His anointed, 
To Dawiḏ and his seed, forever.

19.1:
The shamayim are proclaiming the esteem of Ĕl; 
And the expanse is declaring the work of His hand.
19.2:
Day to day pours forth speech, 
And night to night reveals knowledge.
19.3:
There is no speech, and there are no words, 
Their voice is not heard.
19.4:
Their line has gone out through all the earth, 
And their words to the end of the world. 
In them He put up a tent for the sun,
19.5:
And it is like a bridegroom coming out of his room, 
It rejoices like a strong man to run the path.
19.7:
The Torah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is perfect, bringing back the being; 
The Witness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is trustworthy, making wise the simple;
19.8:
The Orders of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 are straight, rejoicing the heart; 
The Command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is clear, enlightening the eyes;
19.11:
Also, Your servant is warned by them, 
In guarding them there is great reward.
19.12:
Who discerns mistakes? 
Declare me innocent from those that are secret,
19.13:
Also keep Your servant back from presumptuous ones, 
Do not let them rule over me. 
Then shall I be perfect, and innocent of great transgression.
19.14:
Let the words of my mouth 
And the meditation of my heart 
Be pleasing before You, 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, my rock and my redeemer.

2.1:
Why do the gentiles rage, 
And the peoples meditate emptiness?
2.2:
The melaḵim of the earth take their stand, 
And the rulers take counsel together, 
Against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and against His Mashiaḥ,
2.3:
“Let us tear apart Their bonds, 
And throw away Their ropes from us.”
2.4:
He who is sitting in the shamayim laughs, 
Aḏonai mocks at them.
2.5:
Then He speaks to them in His wrath, 
And troubles them in His rage,
2.6:
“But I, I have put Malki 
On Tsiyon, My qodesh mountain.”
2.7:
“I inscribe for a law: 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has said to Me, 
‘You are My Bĕn, 
Today I have brought You forth.
2.8:
‘Ask of Me, 
And I make the gentiles Your inheritance, 
And the ends of the earth Your possession.
2.9:
‘Break them with a rod of iron, 
Dash them to pieces like a potter’s vessel.’ ”
2.10:
And now, be wise, O melaḵim; 
Be instructed, you rulers of the earth.
2.11:
Serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with reverence, 
And rejoice with trembling.
2.12:
Kiss the Bĕn, lest He be enraged, 
And you perish in the way, 
For soon His wrath is to be kindled. 
Ashrĕ are all those taking refuge in Him.

20.1:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 answers you in the day of distress! 
The Name of the Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ exalts you!
20.2:
He sends you help from the qodesh place, 
And upholds you from Tsiyon!
20.3:
He remembers all your offerings, 
And accepts your burnt offering! Selah.
20.4:
He gives you according to your heart, 
And fills all your plans!
20.5:
We sing of Your deliverance, 
And in the Name of our Elohim we raise up a banner!
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 fills all your requests!
20.7:
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, 
But we remember the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim.
20.8:
They, they have bowed down and fallen; 
But we have risen and are established.
20.9:
Save, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
Let the Meleḵ answer us in the day we call.

21.1:
The meleḵ rejoices in Your strength, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
And how greatly he exults in Your deliverance!
21.2:
You have given him the desire of his heart, 
And You have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.
21.3:
For You put before him the bireḵoth of goodness; 
You put a crown of fine gold on his head.
21.4:
He asked life from You and You gave it to him - 
Length of days forever and ever.
21.5:
Through Your deliverance his esteem is great; 
You have laid excellency and splendor on him.
21.6:
For You have made him bireḵoth forever; 
You have made him glad with the joy of Your presence.
21.7:
For the meleḵ is trusting in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And through the kindness of the Most High he is not moved.
21.8:
Your hand reaches all Your enemies; 
Your right hand reaches those who hate You.
21.10:
You destroy their fruit from the earth, 
And their seed from among the sons of men.
21.11:
For they held out evil against You; 
They devised a plot; they do not prevail.
21.12:
For You make them turn their back, 
When You aim with Your bowstring toward their faces.
21.13:
Be exalted, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, in Your strength! 
We sing and we praise Your might.

22.1:
My Ĕl, My Ĕl, why have You forsaken me - 
Far from saving me, and the words of my groaning?
22.2:
O my Elohim, I call by day, but You do not answer; 
And by night, but I find no rest.
22.3:
Yet You are qodesh, 
Enthroned on the praises of Yisra’ĕl.
22.4:
Our fathers trusted in You; 
They trusted, and You delivered them.
22.5:
They cried to You, and were delivered; 
They trusted in You, and were not ashamed.
22.6:
But I am a worm, and no man; 
A reproach of men, and despised by the people.
22.7:
All those who see Me mock Me; 
They shoot out the lip, they shake the head,
22.8:
“He trusted in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, let Him rescue Him; 
Let Him deliver Him, seeing He has delighted in Him!”
22.9:
For You are the One who took Me out of the womb; 
Made me secure on My mother’s breasts.
22.10:
I was cast upon You from birth. 
From My mother’s womb You have been My Ĕl.
22.12:
Many bulls have surrounded Me; 
Strong ones of Bashan have encircled Me.
22.13:
They have opened their mouths against Me, 
As a raging and roaring lion.
22.17:
I count all My bones. 
They look, they stare at Me.
22.18:
They divide My garments among them, 
And for My raiment they cast lots.
22.19:
But You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do not be far off; 
O My Strength, hasten to help Me!
22.20:
Deliver My life from the sword, 
My only one from the power of the dog.
22.21:
Save Me from the mouth of the lion, 
And from the horns of the wild beasts! 
You have answered Me.
22.22:
I make known Your Name to My brothers; 
In the midst of the assembly I praise You.
22.23:
You who revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, praise Him! 
All you seed of Ya’aqoḇ, esteem Him, 
And revere Him, all you seed of Yisra’ĕl!
22.25:
From You is My praise in the great assembly; 
I pay My vows before those who revere Him.
22.27:
Let all the ends of the earth 
Remember and turn to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And all clans of the nations 
Bow themselves before You.
22.28:
For the reign belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
And He is ruling over the nations.
22.29:
All the fat ones of the earth 
Shall eat and bow themselves; 
All who go down to the dust bow before Him, 
Even he who did not keep alive his own life.
22.30:
A seed shall serve Him. 
It is declared of Aḏonai to a generation.
22.31:
They shall come and declare His righteousness 
To a people to be born, 
For He shall do it!

23.1:
A psalm of Dawiḏ. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is my shepherd; 
I do not lack.
23.2:
He makes me to lie down in green pastures; 
He leads me beside still waters.
23.4:
When I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, 
I fear no evil. 
For You are with me; 
Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.
23.6:
Only goodness and kindness follow me 
All the days of my life; 
And I shall dwell in the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
To the length of days!

24.1:
A psalm of Dawiḏ. The earth belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And all that fills it - 
The world and those who dwell in it.
24.2:
For He has founded it upon the seas, 
And upon the waters He establishes it.
24.3:
Who goes up into the mountain of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? 
And who stands in His qodesh place?
24.4:
He who has innocent hands and a clean heart, 
Who did not bring his life to naught, 
And did not swear deceivingly.
24.5:
He receives a beraḵah from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And righteousness from the Elohim of his deliverance.
24.6:
This is the generation of those who seek Him; 
Ya’aqoḇ, who seeks Your face. Selah.
24.7:
Lift up your heads, O you gates! 
And be lifted up, you everlasting doors! 
And let the Meleḵ of esteem come in.
24.8:
Who is this Meleḵ of esteem? 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 strong and mighty,
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 mighty in battle.
24.9:
Lift up your heads, O you gates! 
Even lift up, you everlasting doors! 
And let the Meleḵ of esteem come in.
24.10:
Who is this Meleḵ of esteem? 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts, 
He is the Meleḵ of esteem! Selah.

25.1: Of Dawiḏ. א,𐤀 To You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I lift up my being.
25.3:
ג ,𐤂 Indeed, let no one who waits on You be ashamed; 
Let those who are treacherous without cause be ashamed.
25.4:
ד,𐤃 Show me Your Ways, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Teach me Your paths.
25.5:
ה,𐤄 Lead me in Your truth, 
ו,𐤅 And teach me, 
For You are the Elohim of my deliverance; 
On You I wait all the day.
25.6:
ז,𐤆 Remember, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Your compassion and Your kindnesses, 
For they are from everlasting.
25.8:
ט,𐤈 Good and straight is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Therefore He teaches sinners in the Way.
25.9:
י,𐤉 He guides the meek ones in Right-Ruling, 
And He teaches the meek ones His Way.
25.10:
כ,𐤊 All the paths of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 are kindness and truth, 
To those who guard His Covenant and His Witnesses.
25.11:
ל,𐤋 For Your Name’s sake, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
You shall pardon my wickedness, though it is great.
25.12:
מ,𐤌 Who, then, is the man that reveres 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? 
He teaches him in the Way he should choose.
25.13:
נ,𐤍 His life dwells in good, 
And his seed inherits the earth.
25.14:
ס,𐤎 The secret of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is those who revere Him, 
And He makes His Covenant known to them.
25.15:
ע,𐤏 My eyes are ever toward 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
For He brings my feet out of the net.
25.16:
פ,𐤐 Turn Your face to me, and show me favor, 
For I am lonely and afflicted.
25.17:
צ,𐤑 The distresses of my heart have enlarged; 
Oh, bring me out of my distresses!
25.18:
ר,𐤓 Look on my affliction and my toil, 
And lift all my sins.
25.19:
See how many my enemies have become; 
And they hate me with a violent hatred.
25.20:
שׁ, v Oh, guard my life, and deliver me; 
Let me not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in You.
25.21:
ת,𐤕 Let integrity and straightness guard me, 
For I have waited for You.
25.22:
Redeem Yisra’ĕl, O Elohim, 
Out of all his distresses!

26.1:
Of Dawiḏ. Rule me rightly, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
For I have walked in my integrity. 
And I have trusted in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, without wavering.
26.2:
Examine me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and prove me; 
Try my kidneys and my heart.
26.3:
For Your kindness is before my eyes, 
And I have walked in Your truth.
26.4:
I have not sat with men of falsehood, 
Nor do I enter with pretenders.
26.5:
I have hated the assembly of evil-doers,
And I do not sit with the wicked.
26.6:
I wash my hands in innocence; 
And I walk around Your altar, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,
26.7:
To raise a voice of thanksgiving, 
And to declare all Your wonders.
26.8:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I have loved the abode of Your House, 
And the place where Your esteem dwells.
26.9:
Do not gather my being together with sinners, 
Nor my life with bloodthirsty men,
26.10:
In whose hands is a plot, 
And their right hand is filled with bribes.
26.11:
But as for me, I walk in my integrity; 
Redeem me and show me favor.
26.12:
My foot shall stand on a level place; 
In the assemblies I baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.

27.2:
When evil-doers come against me 
To eat up my flesh, 
My adversaries and my enemies, 
They shall stumble and fall.
27.3:
Though an army encamps against me, 
My heart does not fear; 
Though battle comes up against me, 
Even then I would be trusting.
27.4:
One I asked of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 - this I seek:
To dwell in the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
All the days of my life, 
To see the pleasantness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And to inquire in His Hĕyḵal.
27.7:
Hear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, when I cry with my voice! 
And show me favor, and answer me.
27.8:
To my heart You have said, 
“Seek My face.” 
Your face, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I seek.
27.10:
When my father and my mother have forsaken me, 
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 takes me in.
27.11:
Teach me Your Way, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And lead me in a smooth path, because of my enemies.
27.12:
Do not give me over 
To the desire of my adversaries; 
For false witnesses have risen against me, 
And they breathe out violence to me.
27.13:
What if I had not believed 
To see the goodness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄
In the land of the living!
27.14:
Wait on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, be strong, 
And let Him strengthen your heart! 
Wait, I say, on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!

28.1:
Of Dawiḏ. I cry to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Rock: 
Do not be deaf to me! 
For if You are silent to me, 
I shall be like those who go down to the pit.
28.2:
Hear the voice of my prayers when I cry to You, 
When I lift up my hands 
Toward Your Qodesh Speaking Place.
28.3:
Do not draw me away with the wicked 
And with the workers of wickedness, 
Who speak peace to their neighbors, 
But evil is in their hearts.
28.5:
Because they do not heed the works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Nor the works of His hands, 
He throws them down, 
And does not build them up.
28.6:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Because He has heard the voice of my prayers!
28.8:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is the strength of His people, 
And He is the stronghold of deliverance of His anointed.
28.9:
Save Your people, and baraḵ Your inheritance; 
And be their Shepherd, and bear them up forever.

29.1:
A psalm of Dawiḏ. Ascribe to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O you sons of the mighty, 
Ascribe to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 esteem and strength.
29.2:
Ascribe to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 the esteem of His Name; 
Bow yourselves to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 in the splendor of qodeshah.
29.4:
The voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is with power, 
The voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is with greatness.
29.5:
The voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is breaking the cedars, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is breaking the cedars Leḇanon in pieces.
29.6:
And He makes them skip like a calf, 
Leḇanon and Siryon like a young wild ox.
29.7: The voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 cuts through the flames of fire.
29.8:
The voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shakes the wilderness; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shakes the Wilderness of Qaḏĕsh.
29.10:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sat enthroned at the Flood, 
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sits as Meleḵ forever.
29.11:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gives strength to His people; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 baraḵ His people with peace.

3.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, how my adversaries have increased! 
Many rising up against me.
3.2:
Many are saying of me,
“There is no deliverance for him in Elohim.” Selah.
3.3:
But You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, are a shield for me, 
My esteem, and the One lifting up my head.
3.4:
I cried to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with my voice, 
And He heard me from His qodesh mountain. Selah.
3.5:
I, I lay down and slept; 
I awoke, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sustained me.
3.6:
I am not afraid of ten thousands of people 
Who have turned themselves against me all around.
3.8:
Deliverance belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄. 
Your beraḵah is on Your people. Selah.

30.1:
I exalt You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for You have drawn me up, 
And have not let my enemies rejoice over me.
30.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 My Elohim, 
I have cried to You, 
And You have healed me.
30.3:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, You brought me up from the grave; 
You have kept me alive, from going down into the pit.
30.4:
Sing praise to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
You kind ones of His, 
And give thanks at the remembrance of His Qodeshah.
30.5:
For His displeasure is for a moment, 
His delight is for ḥai; 
Weeping might last for the night, 
But joy comes in the morning.
30.6:
As for me, I have said in my ease, 
“Never would I be shaken!”
30.8:
I cried out to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
And to Aḏonai I prayed:
30.9:
“What gain is there in my blood, 
When I go down to the pit? 
Would dust praise You? 
Would it declare Your truth?
30.10:
“Hear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and show me favor; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, be my helper!”
30.11:
You have turned my mourning into dancing for me; 
You have torn off my sackcloth and girded me with gladness,
30.12:
So that esteem might praise You and not be silent. 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim, I thank You forever.

31.2:
Incline Your ear to me, 
Deliver me speedily; 
Be a rock of refuge to me, 
A house of defense to save me.
31.3:
For You are my rock and my stronghold; 
For Your Name’s sake lead me and guide me.
31.4:
Bring me out of the net which they have hidden for me, 
For You are my stronghold.
31.5:
Into Your hand I commit my spirit; 
You have redeemed me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Ĕl of truth.
31.6:
I have hated those who observe lying vanities; 
But I trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
31.8:
And You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy.
You have stood my feet in a large place.
31.9:
Show me favor, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for I am in distress; 
My eye, my being and my body have become old with grief!
31.10:
For my life is consumed in sorrow, 
And my years in sighing; 
My strength fails because of my wickedness, 
And my bones have become old.
31.11:
I am a reproach among all my adversaries, 
But most of all among my neighbors, 
And a dread to my friends; 
Those who see me outside flee from me.
31.12:
I have been forgotten from the heart, like someone dead; 
I have been like a missing vessel.
31.14:
But I, I have put my trust in You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
I have said, “You are my Elohim.”
31.16:
Make Your face shine upon Your servant; 
Save me in Your kindness.
31.18:
Let lips of falsehood be stilled, 
Which speak recklessly against the righteous, 
With pride and scorn.
31.19:
How great is Your goodness, 
Which You have laid up for those revering You, 
Which You have prepared for those taking refuge in You 
In the sight of the sons of men!
31.21:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
For He has made marvelous His kindness to me in a strong city!
31.22:
And I, I have said in my haste, 
“I am cut off from before Your eyes,”Yet 
You heard the voice of my prayers 
When I cried out to You.
31.23:
Love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, all you His kind ones! 
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 guards the trustworthy ones, 
And exceedingly repays the doer of pride.
31.24:
Be strong, and let Him strengthen your heart, 
All you who are waiting for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.

32.1:
A poem of Dawiḏ. Ashrĕ is he whose transgression is forgiven, 
Whose sin is covered.
32.2:
Ashrĕ is the man to whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 imputes no wickedness, 
And in whose spirit there is no deceit.
32.3:
When I kept silent, my bones became old 
Through my groaning all the day.
32.4:
For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; 
My sap was turned into the droughts of summer. Selah.
32.5:
I acknowledged my sin to You, 
And my wickedness I did not hide. 
I have said, “I confess my transgressions to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄,” 
And You forgave the wickedness of my sin. Selah.
32.6:
Therefore, let every kind one pray to You 
While You might be found; 
Even in a flood of great waters 
They would not reach him.
32.9:
Do not be like the horse, like the mule, 
With no understanding, with bit and bridle, 
Else they do not come near you.”
32.11:
Be glad in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and exult, you righteous; 
And shout for joy, all you upright in heart!

33.1:
Shout for joy in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, you righteous! 
Praise is fitting for the straight!
33.2:
Praise 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with the lyre; 
Sing to Him with an instrument of ten strings.
33.3:
Sing to Him a new song; 
Play sweetly with a shout of joy.
33.4:
For the Word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is straight, 
And all His works are in truth,
33.5:
Loving righteousness and right-ruling;
The earth is filled with the kindness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
33.6:
By the Word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 the shamayim were made, 
And all their host by the breath of His mouth,
33.7:
Gathering the waters of the sea together as a heap; 
Laying up the deep in storehouses.
33.8:
Let all the earth revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
33.9:
For He spoke and it came to be; 
He commanded, and it stood fast.
33.10:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 brings the counsel of the nations to naught; 
He thwarts the plans of the peoples.
33.11:
The counsel of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 stands forever, 
The plans of His heart to all generations.
33.12:
Ashrĕ is the nation whose Elohim is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
The people whom He has chosen as His own inheritance.
33.13:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has looked from the shamayim; 
He has seen all the sons of men.
33.14:
He looked from His dwelling place 
On all the inhabitants of the earth -
33.15:
He who fashions the hearts of them all, 
He who understands all their works.
33.16:
The meleḵ is not saved by the multitude of an army; 
A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
33.17:
A horse is a vain means of safety; 
Neither does it rescue any by its great power.
33.18:
See, the eye of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is on those revering Him, 
On those waiting for His kindness,
33.19:
To deliver their being from death, 
And to keep them alive during scarcity of food.
33.20:
Our being has longed for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Our help and our shield is He.
33.21:
For our heart rejoices in Him, 
For we have put our trust in His qodesh Name.
33.22:
Let Your kindness, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, be upon us, 
Even as we wait for You.

34.1:
א,𐤀 I baraḵ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 at all times; 
His praise is continually in my mouth.
34.2:
ב,𐤁 My being shall boast in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Let the humble hear and be glad.
34.3:
ג ,𐤂 Oh, make 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 great with me, 
And let us exalt His Name together.
34.4:
ד,𐤃 I sought 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and He answered me, 
And delivered me from all my fears.
34.5:
ה,𐤄 They looked to Him and were lightened, 
ו,𐤅 And their faces were not ashamed.
34.6:
ז,𐤆 This poor one cried out and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 heard him, 
And saved him out of all his distresses.
34.7:
ח,𐤇 The messenger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 encamps all around those who revere Him, 
And rescues them.
34.8:
ט,𐤈 Oh, taste and see that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is good; 
Ashrĕ is the man that takes refuge in Him!
34.9:
י,𐤉 Revere 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, you His qodeshim, 
For there is no lack to them who revere Him!
34.10:
כ,𐤊 Young lions have lacked and been hungry; 
But those who seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 lack not any goodness.
34.11:
ל,𐤋 Come, you children, listen to me; 
Let me teach you the reverence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
34.12:
מ,𐤌 Who is the man who desires life, 
Who loves many days, in order to see good?
34.13:
נ,𐤍 Keep your tongue from evil, 
And your lips from speaking deceit.
34.14:
ס,𐤎 Turn away from evil and do good; 
Seek peace, and pursue it.
34.15:
ע,𐤏 The eyes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 are on the righteous, 
And His ears unto their cry.
34.16:
פ,𐤐 The face of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is against evil-doers, 
To cut off their remembrance from the earth.
34.17:
צ,𐤑 Crying out, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 heard, 
And delivered them out of all their distresses.
34.18:
ק,𐤒 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is near to the broken-hearted,
And saves those whose spirit is crushed.
34.19:
ר,𐤓 Many are the evils of the righteous, 
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 delivers him out of them all.
34.20:
שׁ, v He is guarding all his bones; 
Not one of them is broken.
34.21:
Evil slays the wicked, 
ת,𐤕 And those who hate the righteous are guilty.
34.22:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 redeems the lives of His servants, 
And none of those taking refuge in Him are guilty.

35.1:
Of Dawiḏ. O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, strive with those who strive with me; 
Fight against those who fight against me.
35.2:
Take hold of shield and armor, 
And rise for my help.
35.3:
And draw out spear and lance, 
To meet those who pursue me. 
Say to my life, “I am your deliverance.”
35.4:
Let those be ashamed and blush 
Who seek my life; 
Let those be turned back and abashed 
Who plot evil to me.
35.5:
Let them be as chaff before the wind, 
With a messenger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 driving on.
35.6:
Let their way be dark and slippery, 
With a messenger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 pursuing them.
35.7:
For without cause they hid their net for me; 
Without cause they dug a pit for my life.
35.9:
But let my own being exult in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Let it rejoice in His deliverance.
35.10:
Let all my bones say, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, who is like You, 
Delivering the poor from one stronger than he, 
And the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”
35.11:
Malicious witnesses rise up; 
They ask me that which I knew not.
35.12: They reward me evil for good, bereaving my life.
35.14:
I walked about as though he were my friend or brother; 
I bowed down mourning, as one mourning for a mother.
35.16:
With unclean ones, mockers at feasts, 
Gnashing at me with their teeth.
35.17:
Aḏonai, how long would You look on? 
Rescue my being from their destructions, 
My only one from the lions.
35.18:
I give You thanks in the great assembly; 
I praise You among a mighty people.
35.19:
Let not my lying enemies rejoice over me; 
Or those who hate me without cause wink their eyes.
35.20:
For they do not speak peace, 
But they devise words of deceit 
Against the peaceable ones of the land.
35.21:
And they open their mouth wide against me, 
They said, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it.”
35.23:
Stir up Yourself and awake to my right-ruling -
To my cause, my Elohim and Aḏonai.
35.25:
Let them not say in their hearts, 
“Aha, our desire!” 
Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up.”
35.26:
Let those who are rejoicing at my evil 
Be ashamed and abashed altogether; 
Let those who are exalting themselves over me 
Be clad in shame and humiliation.
35.27:
Let those who delight in my righteous cause 
Shout for joy and be glad, 
And let them always say, “Let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 be made great, 
Who is desiring the peace of His servant.”
35.28:
And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness, 
Your praise, 
All day long.

36.1:
Transgression speaks to the wicked within his heart; 
Reverence of Elohim is not before his eyes.
36.2:
For he flatters himself in his own eyes, 
To find his wickedness to be hated.
36.3:
The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit; 
He has ceased to be wise, to do good.
36.5:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Your kindness is in the shamayim, 
And Your trustworthiness reaches to the clouds.
36.7:
How precious is Your kindness, O Elohim!
And the sons of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings.
36.8:
They are filled from the fatness of Your House, 
And You give them drink from the river of Your pleasures.
36.9:
For with You is the fountain of ḥai; 
In Your light we see light.
36.10:
Draw out Your kindness to those who know You, 
And Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
36.11:
Let not the foot of pride come against me, 
And the hand of the wicked drive me away.

37.1:
Of Dawiḏ. א,𐤀 Do not fret because of evil-doers,
Do not be envious of the workers of unrighteousness.
37.2:
For they soon wither like grass, 
And fade like green plants.
37.3:
ב,𐤁 Trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and do good; 
Dwell in the earth, and feed on steadfastness.
37.4:
And delight yourself in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And let Him give you the desires of your heart.
37.5:
ג ,𐤂 Commit your way to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And trust in Him, and He does it.
37.6:
And He shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, 
And your right-ruling as midday.
37.8:
ה,𐤄 Abstain from displeasure, and forsake wrath; 
Neither fret only to do evil.
37.11:
But the meek ones shall inherit the earth, 
And delight themselves in plenty of peace.
37.12:
ז,𐤆 The wicked plots against the righteous, 
And gnashes his teeth at him.
37.13:
Aḏonai laughs at him; 
For He sees that his day is coming.
37.14:
ח,𐤇 The wicked have drawn the sword 
And have bent their bow, 
To cause the poor and needy to fall, 
To slay those who walk straightly.
37.15:
Their sword enters into their own heart, 
And their bows are broken.
37.16:
ט,𐤈 Better is the little of the righteous one, 
Than the riches of many wicked.
37.17:
For the arms of the wicked are broken, 
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sustains the righteous.
37.18:
י,𐤉 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 knows the days of the perfect, 
And their inheritance is forever.
37.19:
They are not ashamed in a time of evil, 
And in the days of scarcity of food they are satisfied.
37.20:
כ,𐤊 But the wicked shall perish; 
And the enemies of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Like the splendor of the meadows they vanish, 
Like smoke they vanish away.
37.21:
ל,𐤋 The wicked borrows and does not repay, 
But the righteous one shows favor and gives.
37.22:
For His beruḵim inherit the earth, 
But those cursed by Him are cut off.
37.23:
מ,𐤌 The steps of a man are ordered by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And He delights in his way.
37.24:
Though he falls, he is not cast down, 
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is supporting his hand.
37.26:
All day long he is showing favor and lending; 
And his seed is for a beraḵah.
37.27:
ס,𐤎 Turn away from evil, and do good; 
And dwell forever.
37.28:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 loves Right-Ruling, 
And does not forsake His kind ones; 
They shall be guarded forever, 
But the seed of the wicked is cut off.
37.29:
The righteous shall inherit the earth, 
And dwell in it forever.
37.30:
פ,𐤐 The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, 
And his tongue talks of Right-Ruling.
37.31:
The Torah of his Elohim is in his heart; 
His steps do not slide.
37.32:
צ,𐤑 The wicked is watching for the righteous, 
And is seeking to slay him.
37.33:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 does not leave him in his hand, 
Or let him be declared wicked when he is judged.
37.34:
ק,𐤒 Wait on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and guard His Way, 
And He shall exalt you to inherit the earth - 
When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
37.35:
ר,𐤓 I have seen the wicked in great power, 
And spreading himself like a native green tree.
37.36:
Yet he passed away, and see, he was not; 
And I sought him, but he was not found.
37.37:
שׁ, v Watch the perfect, and observe the straight; 
For the latter end of each is peace.
37.38:
But the transgressors shall be destroyed together; 
The latter end of the wicked shall be cut off.
37.39:
ת,𐤕 But the deliverance of the righteous is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Their strength in time of distress.

38.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do not rebuke me in Your wrath,
Nor chastise me in Your hot displeasure!
38.2:
For Your arrows have pierced me, 
And Your hand comes down on me.
38.3:
There is no soundness in my flesh because of Your rage, 
Nor peace in my bones because of my sin.
38.4:
For my wickednesses have passed over my head; 
Like a heavy burden, too heavy for me.
38.5:
My wounds stink, festering 
Because of my folly.
38.7:
For my loins have become filled with burning, 
And there is no soundness in my flesh.
38.8:
I have become weak and greatly crushed; 
I howled from the groaning of my heart.
38.9:
Aḏonai, all my desire is before You; 
And my sighing has not been hidden from You.
38.10:
My heart is throbbing, my strength has forsaken me; 
And the light of my eyes also is not with me.
38.11:
My loved ones and my friends stand back from my plague, 
And my neighbors stand far away.
38.13:
But I, as one deaf, do not hear; 
And as a dumb one who does not open his mouth.
38.14:
I am like a man who does not hear, 
And who has no rebukes in his mouth.
38.15:
For on You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I have waited; 
You do answer, O Aḏonai my Elohim.
38.16:
For I said, “Otherwise they would rejoice over me, 
When my foot slips they would exalt themselves over me.”
38.17:
For I am ready to fall, 
And my pain is always with me.
38.18:
For I confess my wickedness; 
I am sorry over my sin.
38.20:
And those who repay evil for good, 
They oppose me, because I follow what is good.
38.21:
Do not forsake me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
O my Elohim be not far from me!
38.22:
Hasten to help me, 
O Aḏonai, my deliverance!

39.1:
I have said, “Let me guard my ways 
Against sinning with my tongue; 
Let me guard my mouth with a muzzle, 
While the wicked is before me.”
39.4:
“𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, let me know my end, 
And the measure of my days, what it is 
Let me know how short-lived I am.
39.7:
“And now, Aḏonai, what do I wait for? 
My expectancy is in You.
39.8:
“Deliver me from all my transgressions; 
Do not make me the reproach of the foolish.
39.9:
“I was dumb, I did not open my mouth, 
Because it was You who did it.
39.10:
“Turn aside Your stroke from me; 
I am overcome by the blow of Your hand.
39.13:
“Look away from me, 
That I might brighten up, 
Before I go away and am no more.”

4.2:
Till when, O you sons of men, 
Would you turn my esteem to shame, 
Would you love emptiness, seek falsehood? Selah.
4.3:
But know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has separated a kind one for Himself; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 hears when I call to Him.
4.4:
Tremble, and do not sin. 
Speak within your heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.
4.5:
Offer slaughterings of righteousness, 
And trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
4.6:
Many are saying, “Who would show us good?” 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, lift up the light of Your face upon us.
4.7:
You have put more gladness in my heart, 
Than in the season that their grain and wine increased.
4.8:
I lie down in peace altogether, and sleep; 
For You alone, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, make me dwell in safety.

40.1:
I waited for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
And He inclined to me, and heard my cry.
40.2:
And He drew me 
Out of the pit of destruction, 
Out of the muddy clay, 
And He put my feet upon a rock, 
He is establishing my steps.
40.4:
Ashrĕ is that man who has made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 his trust, 
And has not turned to the proud, 
And those turning aside to falsehood.
40.7:
Then I said, “See, I have come; 
In the scroll of the Book it is prescribed for me.
40.8:
I have delighted to do Your pleasure, O my Elohim, 
And Your Torah is within my inward parts.”
40.11:
Do not withhold Your compassion from me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
Let Your kindness and Your truth always watch over me.
40.13:
Be pleased, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, to deliver me; 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, hasten to help me!
40.14:
Let those who seek to destroy my life 
Be ashamed and abashed altogether; 
Let those who are desiring my evil 
Be driven back and put to shame.
40.15:
Let those who say to me, 
“Aha, aha!” 
Be appalled at their own shame.
40.16:
Let all those who seek You 
Rejoice and be glad in You; 
Let those who love Your deliverance always say, 
“𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 be exalted!”

41.1:
Ashrĕ is he who considers the poor; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 delivers him in a day of evil.
41.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 guards him and keeps him alive; 
He is called fortunate on the earth, 
And You do not hand him over 
To the desire of his enemies.
41.3:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 sustains him on his sickbed; 
In his weakness on his bed You bring a change.
41.5:
My enemies speak evil of me,
“When he dies, his name shall perish.”
41.7:
All who hate me whisper together against me; 
They plot evil to me,
41.8:
“A matter of Beliya’al is poured out on him, 
That when he lies down, he would not rise again.”
41.9:
Even my own friend in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, 
Has lifted up his heel against me.
41.10:
But You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, show me favor and raise me up, 
And let me repay them.
41.11:
By this I know that You delight in me, 
Because my enemy does not shout for joy over me.
41.12:
And I, You uphold me in my integrity, 
And place me before Your face forever.
41.13:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of Yisra’ĕl
From everlasting to everlasting! 
Amĕn and Amĕn.

42.1:
As a deer longs for the water streams, 
So my being longs for You, O Elohim.
42.2:
My being thirsts for Elohim, for the living Ĕl. 
When shall I enter in to appear before Elohim?
42.3:
My tears have been my food day and night, 
While they say to me all day, 
“Where is your Elohim?”
42.4:
These I remember, and pour out my being within me. 
For I used to pass along with the throng; 
I went with them to the House of Elohim, 
With the voice of joy and praise, 
A multitude celebrating a Festival!
42.5:
Why are you depressed, O my being?
And you restless within me?
Wait for Elohim: for I shall yet thank Him,
The deliverance of His face!
42.6:
O my Elohim, my being is depressed within me; 
Therefore I remember You from the land of the Yardĕn, 
And from the heights of Ḥermon, 
From Mount Mits’ar.
42.7:
Deep calls to deep at the sound of Your waterfalls; 
All Your waves and breakers passed over me.
42.9:
I say to Ĕl my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me?
Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
42.10:
My enemies have reproached me, 
Like a crushing of my bones, 
While they say to me all day long, 
“Where is your Elohim?”
42.11:
Why are you depressed, O my being?
And why are you restless within me?
Wait for Elohim: for I shall yet thank Him, the deliverance of my face, 
And my Elohim.

43.1:
Rule me rightly, O Elohim,
And plead my cause against a nation without kindness. 
Oh, deliver me from a man of deceit and unrighteousness!
43.2:
For You are the Elohim of my strength. 
Why have You rejected me? 
Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
43.3:
Send forth Your light and Your truth!
Let them lead me,
Let them bring me to Your qodesh mountain 
And to Your Mishkanoth.
43.4:
That I might come to the altar of Elohim, 
To Ĕl, the joy of my delight, 
And praise You with the lyre, 
O Elohim, my Elohim.
43.5:
Why are you depressed, O my being? 
And why are you restless within me? 
Wait for Elohim: for I shall yet thank Him, the deliverance of my face, 
And my Elohim.

44.1:
O Elohim, we have heard with our ears, 
Our fathers have related to us, 
The work You did in their days, 
In the days of old.
44.2:
You drove out the nations with Your hand, 
But them You planted. 
You afflicted peoples, and sent them out.
44.3:
For not by their own sword did they possess the land, 
Neither did their own arm save them; 
But it was Your right hand and Your arm, 
And the light of Your face, 
Because You delighted in them.
44.4:
You Yourself are Malki, O Elohim; 
Command deliverances for Ya’aqoḇ.
44.5:
Through You we push our enemies; 
Through Your Name we tread down those who rise up against us.
44.6:
For I do not trust in my bow, 
And my sword does not save me.
44.7:
For You have saved us from our enemies, 
And have put to shame those who hated us.
44.8:
In Elohim we shall boast all day long, 
And praise Your Name forever. Selah.
44.9:
Yet You have rejected us and put us to shame, 
And You do not go with our armies.
44.10:
You make us turn back from the adversary, 
And those who hate us have plundered us.
44.11:
You give us as sheep to be eaten, 
And You have scattered us among the gentiles.
44.12:
You sell Your people for no value, 
And have put no high price on them.
44.13:
You make us a reproach to our neighbors, 
A scorn and a mockery to those round about us.
44.14:
You make us a proverb among the nations, 
A shaking of the head among the peoples.
44.15:
My reproach is always before me, 
And the shame of my face has covered me,
44.16:
Because of the voice of the slanderer and blasphemer, 
Because of the enemy and avenger.
44.18:
Our heart has not turned back, 
Neither has our step swerved from Your Way,
44.19:
Yet You have crushed us in the place of jackals, 
And covered us with the shadow of death.
44.20:
If we have forgotten the Name of our Elohim, 
Or stretched out our hands to a foreign mighty one,
44.21:
Would Elohim not search this out? 
For He knows the secrets of the heart.
44.22:
But for Your sake we are killed all day long; 
Reckoned as sheep for the slaughter.
44.23:
Awake! Why do You sleep, O Aḏonai? 
Arise! Do not reject us forever.
44.24:
Why do You hide Your face, 
Ignoring our affliction and our oppression?
44.25:
For our being is bowed down to the dust; 
Our body clings to the earth.
44.26:
Arise, be our help, 
And redeem us for Your kindness’ sake.

45.3:
Gird Your sword upon thigh, O Mighty One, 
Your excellency and Your splendor.
45.5:
Your arrows are sharp 
In the heart of the Meleḵ’s enemies - 
Peoples fall under You.
45.9:
Daughters of melaḵim are among Your precious ones; 
At Your right hand stands the queen consort in gold from Ophir.
45.11:
And let the Meleḵ delight in your loveliness; 
Because He is your Aḏon - bow yourself to Him.
45.12:
And the daughter of Tsor with a gift, 
The rich among the people seek Your favor.
45.15:
They are brought with gladness and rejoicing; 
They enter the Meleḵ’s palace.
45.16:
Instead of Your fathers are Your sons, 
Whom You appoint princes in all the earth.
45.17:
I cause Your Name to be remembered in all generations; 
Therefore the people praise You forever and ever.

46.1:
Elohim is our refuge and strength, 
A help in distress, soon found.
46.2:
Therefore we do not fear, 
Though the earth reels 
And mountains topple into the heart of the seas.
46.3:
Let its waters rage, foam; 
Let mountains shake with its swelling. Selah.
46.4:
A river whose streams 
Make glad the city of Elohim, 
The qodesh dwelling of the Most High.
46.5:
Elohim is in her midst, she does not topple; 
Elohim helps her when morning turns.
46.6:
The gentiles shall rage, 
Reigns shall topple; 
He shall give forth His voice, 
The earth melts.
46.7:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts is with us; 
The Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ is our refuge. Selah.
46.8:
Come, see the works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
The ruins He has wrought on the earth,
46.9:
Causing fighting to cease, 
Unto the end of the earth. 
He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; 
He burns the chariot with fire.
46.11:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts is with us; 
The Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ is our refuge. Selah.

47.1:
Oh, clap your hands, all you peoples! 
Shout to Elohim with a voice of singing!
47.2:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Most High is awesome; 
A great Meleḵ over all the earth.
47.3:
He subdues peoples under us, 
And nations under our feet.
47.4:
He chooses our inheritance for us, 
The excellence of Ya’aqoḇ whom He loves. Selah.
47.5:
Elohim shall go up with a shout, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with the sound of a ram’s horn.
47.6:
Sing praises to Elohim, sing praises! 
Sing praises to our Meleḵ, sing praises!
47.7:
For Elohim is Meleḵ of all the earth; 
Sing praises with understanding.
47.8:
Elohim shall reign over the nations; 
Elohim shall sit on His qodesh throne.
47.9:
Nobles of peoples shall be gathered together, 
The people of the Elohim of Aḇraham. 
For the shields of the earth belong to Elohim; 
He shall be greatly exalted.

48.1:
Great is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and greatly to be praised 
In the city of our Elohim, 
His qodesh mountain.
48.2:
Pretty on high, 
The joy of all the earth, 
Is Mount Tsiyon on the sides of the north, 
The city of the great Meleḵ.
48.3:
Elohim is in her citadels; 
He is known as her refuge.
48.4:
For look, the melaḵim met, 
They passed by together.
48.5:
They saw, so they marveled; 
They were alarmed, they hastened away.
48.6:
Trembling took hold of them there, 
Pain, as of a woman in labor,
48.7: With an east wind You break the ships of Tarshish.
48.8:
As we have heard, so we have seen 
In the city of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts, 
In the city of our Elohim, 
Elohim establishes her forever. Selah.
48.9:
We have thought, O Elohim, of Your kindness, 
In the midst of Your Hĕyḵal.
48.11:
Let Mount Tsiyon rejoice, 
Let the daughters of Yahuḏah exult, 
Because of Your Right-Rulings.
48.14:
For this Elohim is our Elohim, 
Forever and ever; 
He Himself leads us, 
Even to death.

49.1:
Hear this, all you peoples; 
Give ear, all you inhabitants of the world,
49.2:
Both sons of Aḏam and sons of man, 
Rich and poor together.
49.3:
My mouth speaks wisdom, 
And the meditation of my heart brings understanding.
49.4:
I incline my ear to a parable; 
I expound my riddle on the lyre.
49.5:
Why should I fear in the days of evil, 
When the wickedness of my supplanters surrounds me?
49.6:
Those who are trusting in their riches 
And who are boasting in their great wealth?
49.7:
A brother does not redeem anyone at all; 
Neither give to Elohim a ransom for him;
49.8:
For the redemption of their lives is costly, 
And it shall cease forever;
49.9:
That he should still live forever, 
Not see the pit.
49.10:
For he sees wise men die, 
The foolish and the ignorant both perish, 
And shall leave their wealth to others.
49.12:
But man does not remain in esteem; 
He is like the beasts that perish.
49.13:
This way of theirs is folly to them, 
Yet their followers are pleased with their words. Selah.
49.15:
But Elohim redeems my being 
From the power of the grave, 
For He receives me. Selah.
49.16:
Do not be afraid when a man becomes rich, 
When the wealth of his house increases;
49.17:
For when he dies he takes none of it; 
His wealth does not go down after him.
49.18:
Though while he lived he baraḵ himself, 
And though they praise you when you do well for yourself,
49.19:
He has to go to the generation of his fathers; 
They never see the light.
49.20:
Man, who is rich, 
Yet does not understand, 
Shall be like the beasts, 
They shall perish.

5.1:
Give ear to my words, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Consider my meditation.
5.2:
Attend to the voice of my cry, 
Malki and my Elohim, 
For unto You I pray.
5.3:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, in the morning You hear my voice; 
I present myself to You in the morning, and I look up.
5.4:
For You are not an Ĕl taking delight in wickedness, 
Nor does evil dwell with You.
5.5:
The boasters do not stand before Your eyes; 
You hate all workers of wickedness.
5.6:
You destroy those speaking falsehood; 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 loathes a man of blood and deceit.
5.8:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, lead me in Your righteousness because of those watching me;
Make Your way straight before my face.
5.10:
Declare them guilty, O Elohim! 
Let them fall by their own counsels; 
Thrust them away for their many transgressions, 
Because they have rebelled against You.
5.12:
For You baraḵ the righteous, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
You surround him with favor as with a shield.

50.1:
A psalm of Asaph. Ĕl Elohim 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall speak, 
And He shall call the earth 
From the rising of the sun to its going down.
50.2:
From Tsiyon, the perfection of loveliness, 
Elohim shall shine forth.
50.3:
Our Elohim comes, and is not silent - 
A fire consumes before Him, 
And it shall be very stormy all around Him.
50.4:
He calls to the shamayim from above, 
And to the earth, to rightly rule His people:
50.5:
“Gather My kind ones together to Me, 
Those who have made a Covenant with Me by slaughtering.”
50.6:
Then the shamayim declared His righteousness, 
For Elohim Himself is Judge. Selah.
50.7:
“Hear, O My people, and I speak, 
O Yisra’ĕl, and I witness against you:
I am Elohim, your Elohim!
50.8:
“I do not reprove you for your slaughterings, 
And your burnt offerings are continually before Me.
50.9:
“I do not take a bull from your house, 
Nor goats out of your pens.
50.10:
“For every beast of the forest is Mine, 
The cattle on a thousand hills.
50.11:
“I know all the birds of the mountains, 
And all moving in My field are Mine.
50.12:
“If I were hungry, I would not speak to you; 
For the world is Mine, and all that fills it.
50.13:
“Do I eat the flesh of bulls, 
Or drink the blood of goats?
50.14:
“Offer thanksgiving to Elohim, 
And pay your vows to the Most High.
50.15:
“And call upon Me in the day of distress - 
Let Me rescue you, and you esteem Me.”
50.16:
But to the wicked, Elohim said, 
“What right have you to recite My Laws, 
Or take My Covenant in your mouth,
50.17:
“While you hated instruction 
And cast My Words behind you?
50.18:
“When you saw a thief, you were pleased with him, 
And you take part with adulterers.
50.19:
“You let your mouth loose to evil, 
And your tongue frames deceit.
50.20:
“You sit, speak against your brother; 
You slander your own mother’s son.
50.22:
“Understand this please, you who forget Eloah, 
Lest I tear you in pieces, 
With no one to deliver:

51.1:
Show me favor, O Elohim, 
According to Your kindness; 
According to the greatness of Your compassion, 
Blot out my transgressions.
51.2:
Wash me completely from my guilt, 
And cleanse me from my sin.
51.3:
For I know my transgressions, 
And my sin is ever before me.
51.5:
See, I was brought forth in wickedness, 
And in sin my mother conceived me.
51.6:
See, You have desired truth in the inward parts, 
And in the hidden part You make me know wisdom.
51.7:
Cleanse me with hyssop, and I am clean; 
Wash me, and I am whiter than snow.
51.8:
Let me hear joy and gladness, 
Let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
51.9:
Hide Your face from my sins, 
And blot out all my wickednesses.
51.10:
Create in me a clean heart, O Elohim, 
And renew a steadfast spirit within me.
51.11:
Do not cast me away from Your presence, 
And do not take Your Ruaḥ ha’Qodesh from me.
51.12:
Restore to me the joy of Your deliverance, 
And uphold me, Noble Ruaḥ!
51.13:
Let me teach transgressors Your Ways, 
So that sinners turn back to You.
51.14:
Deliver me from blood-guilt, O Elohim, 
Elohim of my deliverance, 
Let my tongue sing aloud of Your righteousness.
51.15:
O Aḏonai, open my lips, 
And that my mouth declare Your praise.
51.16:
For You do not desire slaughtering, or I would give it; 
You do not delight in burnt offering.
51.17:
The slaughterings of Elohim are a broken spirit, 
A heart broken and crushed, O Elohim, 
These You do not despise.
51.18:
Do good in Your good pleasure to Tsiyon; 
Build the walls of Yerushalayim.

52.1:
Why do you boast in evil, O mighty man?
The kindness of Ĕl is all day long!
52.2:
Your tongue devises destruction, 
Like a sharp razor, working deceit.
52.3:
You loved evil more than good, 
Lying more than speaking righteousness. Selah.
52.4:
You loved all devouring words, 
O tongue of deceit.
52.5:
Let Ĕl also break you down forever, 
Take you and pluck you out of your tent. 
And He shall uproot you 
From the land of the living. Selah.
52.6:
And let the righteous see and revere, 
And laugh at him,
52.7:
“See the man who did not make Elohim his strength, 
But trusted in his many riches, 
Being strong in his destruction.”
52.8:
But I am like a green olive tree 
In the House of Elohim, 
I have trusted in the kindness of Elohim 
Forever and ever.
52.9:
I thank You forever, 
Because You have done it; 
And in the presence of Your kind ones 
I wait on Your Name, for it is good.

53.1:
The fool has said in his heart, 
“There is no Elohim.” 
They have done corruptly, 
And they have done abominable unrighteousness; 
No one does good.
53.2:
Elohim looked down from the shamayim on the 
children of men, 
To see if there is a wise one, seeking Elohim.
53.4:
Have the workers of wickedness no knowledge, 
Who eat up my people as they eat bread, 
And do not call on Elohim?
53.5:
There they are in great fear, 
Where no fear was, 
For Elohim shall scatter the bones 
Of him who encamps against you. 
You shall put them to shame, 
For Elohim has rejected them.
53.6:
O that the deliverance of Yisra’ĕl 
Would be given out of Tsiyon!When 
Elohim turns back the captivity of His people, 
Let Ya’aqoḇ rejoice, let Yisra’ĕl be glad.

54.1:
O Elohim, save me by Your Name, 
And rightly rule me by Your might.
54.2:
Hear my prayer, O Elohim; 
Give ear to the words of my mouth.
54.4:
See Elohim is my helper; 
Aḏonai is with those who sustain my life.
54.5:
He repays evil to my enemies. 
Cut them off in Your truth.
54.6:
Voluntarily I slaughter to You; 
I praise Your Name, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for it is good.
54.7:
For He has delivered me out of all distress; 
And my eye has looked upon my enemies.

55.1:
Give ear to my prayer, O Elohim, 
And do not hide Yourself from my plea.
55.2:
Give heed to me, and answer me; 
I wander and moan in my complaint,
55.3:
Because of the noise of the enemy, 
Because of the outcry of the wicked; 
For they bring down wickedness upon me, 
And in wrath they hate me.
55.4:
My heart is pained within me, 
And the fears of death have fallen upon me.
55.5:
Fear and trembling have come upon me, 
And shuddering covers me.
55.6:
And I said, “Who would give me wings like a dove? 
I would fly away and be at rest.
55.7:
“See, I would wander far off, 
I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah.
55.8:
“I would hasten my escape 
From the raging wind and storm.”
55.9:
Confuse, O Aḏonai, divide their tongues, 
For I saw violence and strife in the city.
55.10:
Day and night they go around it on its walls; 
Wickedness and trouble are also in the midst of it.
55.11:
Covetings are in its midst; 
Oppression and deceit do not vanish from its streets.
55.12:
It is not an enemy who reproaches me 
That I could bear; 
Nor one who hates me who is making himself great against me. 
Then I could hide from him.
55.13:
But it was you, a man my equal, 
My companion and my friend.
55.14:
We took sweet counsel together, 
We walked to the House of Elohim in the throng.
55.16:
I, I call upon Elohim, 
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 saves me.
55.17:
Evening and morning and at noon 
I complain and moan, 
And He hears my voice.
55.18:
He has redeemed my life in peace 
From the battle against me, 
For there were many against me.
55.19:
Ĕl, even He who dwells from of old, 
Hears and afflicts them. Selah 
Those with whom there are no changes, 
Those who do not revere Elohim.
55.21:
His mouth was smoother than curds, 
Yet in his heart is fighting; 
His words were softer than oil, 
But they are drawn swords.

56.2:
My enemies would swallow me up all day long, 
For many are fighting against me, O Most High.
56.3: In the day I am afraid, I trust in You.
56.5:
All day long they twist my words; 
All their thoughts are against me for evil.
56.6:
They stir up strife, they hide, 
They watch my steps, 
As they lie in wait for my life.
56.7:
Because of wickedness cast them out. 
Put down the peoples in displeasure, O Elohim!
56.9:
My enemies turn back in the day I call; 
This I know, because Elohim is for me.
56.10:
In Elohim, whose Word I praise, 
In 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, whose Word I praise,
56.12:
On me, O Elohim, are Your vows; 
I render praises to You,
56.13:
For You have delivered my life from death, 
My feet from stumbling, 
That I might walk before Elohim, 
In the light of the living!

57.1:
Show me favor, O Elohim, show me favor! 
For in You my being is taking refuge; 
And in the shadow of Your wings I take refuge, 
Until destruction passes by.
57.2:
I cry out to the Most High Elohim, 
To Ĕl who does perfectly for me.
57.4:
My being is in the midst of lions; 
I lie burning, 
Sons of men whose teeth are spears and arrows, 
And their tongue is a sharp sword.
57.5:
Be exalted, O Elohim, above the shamayim; 
Let Your esteem be above all the earth.
57.8:
Awake, my esteem! 
Awake, harp and lyre! 
I awake the dawn.
57.10:
For Your kindness is great up to the shamayim, 
And Your truth unto the clouds.

58.1:
Would you indeed speak righteousness, in silence? 
Do you judge straightly, you sons of men?
58.2:
No, in heart you work unrighteousness; 
On earth you weigh out the violence of your hands.
58.3:
The wicked have been estranged from the womb; 
These who speak lies go astray from birth.
58.4:
Their poison is like the poison of a snake; 
Like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
58.5:
So as not to hear the voice of whisperers, 
Or a skilled caster of spells.
58.6:
O Elohim, break their teeth in their mouth! 
Break out the fangs of the young lions, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!
58.7:
Let them melt, let them vanish as water; 
Let Him aim His arrows that they be cut down;
58.8:
Like a snail which melts away as it moves, 
Like a woman’s stillbirth, 
Let them not see the sun!
58.9:
Before you feel your thorns or bramble, 
He sweeps them away alive in wrath.
58.10:
The righteous rejoices when he has seen the vengeance, 
He washes his feet in the blood of the wicked,
58.11:
And man says, “Truly, the righteous are rewarded; 
Truly, there is an Elohim judging in the earth.”

59.1:
Deliver me from my enemies, O my Elohim; 
Place me on high from those who rise up against me.
59.2:
Deliver me from the workers of wickedness, 
And save me from men of blood.
59.4:
For no wickedness! 
They run and prepare themselves. 
Awake to help me, and see!
59.5:
And You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of hosts, 
Elohim of Yisra’ĕl, 
Awake to punish all the gentiles; 
Show no favor to any wicked traitors. Selah.
59.6:
They return at evening, 
They howl like a dog, 
And go around the city.
59.7:
See, they belch out with their mouth, 
Swords are in their lips, 
For who is listening?
59.8:
But You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, laugh at them, 
You mock all the gentiles.
59.9:
O my Strength, I wait for You; 
For Elohim is my strong tower.
59.10:
My Elohim of kindness goes before me; 
Elohim lets me look upon my enemies.
59.12:
The sin of their mouth is the words of their lips, 
And they are captured in their pride, 
And for the cursing and lying they utter.
59.13:
Bring to an end in wrath, 
Bring to an end, 
That they be no more; 
And let them know 
That Elohim is ruling in Ya’aqoḇ 
To the ends of the earth. Selah.
59.14:
And at evening they return, 
They howl like a dog, 
And go around the city.
59.15:
They wander up and down for food, 
And whine if they are not satisfied.

6.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, do not rebuke me in Your displeasure, 
Nor discipline me in Your wrath.
6.2:
Show favor to me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for I am fading away; 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, heal me, for my bones have been troubled.
6.3:
And my being has been greatly troubled; 
And You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 - till when?
6.4:
Return, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, rescue my life! 
Oh, save me for Your kindness’ sake!
6.5:
For in death there is no remembrance of You; 
Who gives You thanks in the grave?
6.7:
My eye has grown dim because of grief; 
It grows old because of all my adversaries.
6.8:
Depart from me, all you workers of wickedness; 
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has heard the voice of my weeping.
6.9:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has heard my pleading;
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 receives my prayer.
6.10:
Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; 
They turn back suddenly, ashamed.

60.3:
You have let Your people see hardship; 
You have made us drink the wine of reeling.
60.4:
You have given a banner to those who revere You, 
That it might be lifted up 
Because of the truth. Selah.
60.5:
That those You love might be rescued, 
Save with Your right hand and answer me.
60.6:
Elohim has spoken in His qodeshah, 
“I exult, I portion out Sheḵem 
And measure out the Valley of Sukkoth.
60.7:
“Gil’aḏ is Mine and Menashsheh is Mine, 
And Ephrayim is the defense of My head, 
Yahuḏah is My lawgiver.
60.8:
“Mo’aḇ is My wash-pot, 
Over Eḏom I cast My shoe, 
Shout loud, O Pelesheth, because of Me.”
60.9:
Who would bring me to the strong city? 
Who shall lead me to Eḏom?
60.10:
Have not You, O Elohim, rejected us? 
And You do not go out, O Elohim, 
With our armies!
60.11:
Give us help from distress, 
For the help of man is naught.
60.12:
In Elohim we do mightily, 
And He treads down our adversaries!

61.1:
Hear my cry, O Elohim, 
Listen to my prayer.
61.3:
For You have been my refuge, 
A strong tower in the face of the enemy.
61.4:
Let me dwell in Your Tent forever; 
Let me take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah.
61.6:
You add days to the days of the meleḵ, 
His years as many generations.
61.7:
Let him dwell forever before Elohim. 
Prepare kindness and truth to preserve him!
61.8:
So I sing praise to Your Name forever, 
When I pay my vows day by day.

62.1:
My being finds rest in Elohim alone; 
From Him is my deliverance.
62.2:
He alone is my rock and my deliverance, my strong tower; 
I am not greatly shaken.
62.3:
How long would you assail a man? 
You crush him, all of you, 
Like a leaning wall, a tottering fence.
62.5:
My being, finds rest in Elohim alone, 
Because my expectation is from Him.
62.6:
He alone is my rock and my deliverance, my strong tower; 
I am not shaken.
62.7:
In Elohim is my deliverance and my esteem; 
The rock of my strength, my refuge is in Elohim.
62.9:
Sons of Aḏam are but a breath, 
Sons of men are a lie; 
If weighed in the scales, 
They are altogether lighter than breath.
62.10:
Do not trust in oppression. 
And do not become vain in robbery; 
If riches increase, 
Do not apply your heart to them.
62.11:
Elohim has spoken once, 
Twice I have heard this: 
That strength belongs to Elohim.
62.12:
And kindness is Yours, O Aḏonai; 
For You reward each one according to his work.

63.2:
Therefore I have had a vision of You 
In the qodesh place, 
To see Your power and Your esteem.
63.3:
Because Your kindness is better than life, 
My lips praise You.
63.4:
Therefore I baraḵ You while I live; 
In Your Name I lift up my hands.
63.5:
My being is satisfied as with marrow and fatness, 
And my mouth praises You with singing lips.
63.6:
When I remember You on my bed, 
I meditate on You in the night watches.
63.7:
For You have been my help, 
And in the shadow of Your wings I sing.
63.8:
My being has closely followed You; 
Your right hand upholds me.
63.9:
But those who seek to destroy my life, 
Go into the lower parts of the earth.

64.1:
Hear my voice, O Elohim, in my meditation; 
Guard my life from the threats of the enemy.
64.2:
Hide me from the secret plans of the evil-doers, 
From the tumult of the workers of wickedness,
64.3:
Who sharpen their tongue like a sword, 
And aim their arrows, a bitter word,
64.4:
To shoot in ambush at someone blameless, 
They shoot at him suddenly and do not fear.
64.6:
They search out unrighteousness’s, 
“We have perfected a well searched out plan.” 
For the inward part of man, and heart, are deep.
64.7:
But Elohim shoots at them with an arrow; 
Their wounds shall be sudden.
64.9:
And all men revere, 
And declare the work of Elohim. 
And they shall wisely consider 
What He has done.
64.10:
The righteous rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And shall take refuge in Him, 
And all the upright in heart do praise.

65.1:
To You, stillness, praise, in Tsiyon, O Elohim; 
And to You a vow is paid.
65.2: To You who hears all prayer, all flesh comes.
65.4:
Ashrĕ is the one You choose, 
And bring near to dwell in Your courts. 
We are satisfied with the goodness of Your House, 
Your qodesh Hĕyḵal.
65.5:
By awesome deeds in righteousness You answer us, 
O Elohim of our deliverance, 
The Trust of all the ends of the earth, 
And the distant seas;
65.6:
Who established the mountains by His strength, 
Being girded with might;
65.7:
Who stills the roaring of the seas, 
The roaring of their waves, 
And the uproar of the peoples.
65.10:
Its ridges have been filled, 
Its furrows have been deepened, 
You make it soft with showers, 
You baraḵ its growth.
65.11:
You have crowned the year with Your goodness, 
And Your paths drip with fatness.
65.12:
The pastures of the wilderness drip, 
And the hills are girded with rejoicing.

66.1:
To the chief singer. A psalm, a song. Shout with joy to Elohim, 
All the earth!
66.2:
Sing out the splendor of His Name; 
Make His praise esteemed.
66.3:
Say to Elohim, “How awesome are Your works! 
Through the greatness of Your power 
Your enemies pretend obedience to You.
66.4:
“All the earth bow to You, 
They sing praises to You, 
They praise Your Name.” Selah.
66.5:
Come and see the works of Elohim, 
Awesome acts toward the sons of men.
66.6:
He has turned the sea into dry land, 
They went through the river on foot. 
There we rejoiced in Him,
66.8:
Baraḵ our Elohim, you peoples! 
And sound His praise abroad,
66.9:
Who keeps us in life, 
And does not allow our feet to be moved.
66.10:
For You, O Elohim, have proved us; 
You have refined us as silver is refined.
66.11:
You brought us into the net; 
You laid affliction on our loins.
66.13:
I enter Your house with burnt offerings; 
I complete my vows to You,
66.14:
That which my lips have uttered 
And my mouth spoke in my distress.
66.16:
Come, hear, all you who revere Elohim, 
And I relate what He has done for my being.
66.17:
I called to Him with my mouth, 
And praise was in my tongue.
66.18:
If I have seen wickedness in my heart, 
Aḏonai would not hear.
66.19:
Truly, Elohim has heard me; 
He has given heed to the voice of my prayer.
66.20:
Baruḵ be Elohim, 
Who has not turned away my prayer, 
Nor His kindness from me!

67.1:
Elohim favors us and baraḵ us, 
Cause His face to shine upon us. Selah.
67.2:
For Your Way to be known on earth, 
Your deliverance among all nations.
67.3:
Let the peoples praise You, O Elohim, 
Let all the peoples praise You.
67.4:
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy! 
For You judge the peoples uprightly, 
And lead the nations on earth. Selah.
67.5:
Let the peoples praise You, O Elohim; 
Let all the peoples praise You.
67.6:
The earth shall give her increase; 
Elohim, our own Elohim, baraḵ us!
67.7:
Elohim baraḵ us! 
And all the ends of the earth revere Him!

68.1:
Elohim arises, His enemies are scattered. 
And those who hate Him flee before Him!
68.2:
As smoke is driven away, 
You drive away; 
As wax melts before the fire, 
The wicked perish before Elohim.
68.3:
But the righteous are glad, 
They exult before Elohim. 
And they rejoice with gladness.
68.4:
Sing to Elohim, sing praises to His Name. 
Raise up a highway for Him 
Who rides through the deserts, 
By His Name Yah, 
And exult before Him.
68.5:
Father of the fatherless, 
And Right-Ruler of widows, 
Is Elohim in His qodesh dwelling.
68.7:
O Elohim, when You went out before Your people, 
When You stepped through the wilderness, Selah.
68.8:
The earth shook and the shamayim dropped before Elohim, 
This Sinai, shook before Elohim, the Elohim of Yisra’ĕl.
68.9:
You, O Elohim, sent a shower of plenty, 
You confirmed Your inheritance, 
When it was weary.
68.10:
Your flock dwelt in it; 
You provided from Your goodness for the poor, O Elohim.
68.11:
Aḏonai gave the Word; 
The women who proclaimed it was a great company:
68.12:
“Melaḵim of armies flee in haste! 
And she who remains at home divides the spoil.”
68.13:
If you lie down among the sheepfolds, 
The wings of a dove are covered with silver, 
And her feathers with yellow gold.
68.14:
When Ĕl Shaddai scattered melaḵim in it, 
It snowed in Tsalmon.
68.15:
A mountain of Elohim is the mountain of Bashan; 
A mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan.
68.16:
O mountain of peaks, why do you gaze in envy 
At the mountain which Elohim desired to dwell in? 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 even dwells forever.
68.17:
The chariots of Elohim are twenty thousand, 
Thousands of thousands; 
Aḏonai came from Sinai 
Into the qodesh place.
68.18:
You have ascended on high, 
You have led captivity captive, 
You have received gifts among men, 
And even the rebellious, 
That Yah Elohim might dwell.
68.19:
Baruḵ be Aḏonai, 
Day by day He bears our burden, 
The Ĕl of our deliverance! Selah.
68.20:
Our Ĕl is the Ĕl of deliverance; 
And to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Aḏonai belong escapes from death.
68.21:
Indeed, Elohim smites the head of His enemies, 
The hairy scalp of him who walks about in His guilt.
68.22:
Aḏonai said, “I bring back from Bashan, 
I bring back from the depths of the sea,
68.24:
They have seen Your goings, O Elohim, 
The goings of my Ĕl, Malki, 
Into the qodesh place.
68.26:
Baraḵ Elohim in the assemblies, 
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, from the fountain of Yisra’ĕl.
68.27:
There is Binyamin, the smallest, their ruler, 
The leaders of Yahuḏah, their company, 
The leader of Zeḇulun, the leader of Naphtali.
68.28:
Your Elohim has commanded your strength, be strong! 
O Elohim, this You have worked out for us!
68.29:
Because of Your Hĕyḵal at Yerushalayim, 
Melaḵim bring presents to You.
68.30:
Rebuke the wild beasts of the reeds, 
The herd of bulls, with the calves of the peoples, 
Each one humbling himself with pieces of silver. 
Scatter the peoples who delight in conflicts!
68.31:
Ambassadors come out of Mitsrayim; 
Kush stretches out her hands to Elohim.
68.32:
Sing to Elohim, you reigns of the earth, 
Praises to Aḏonai, Selah.
68.33:
To Him who rides on the ancient highest shamayim! 
See, He sends out His voice, a mighty voice.
68.35:
O Elohim, awesome from Your Miqdashim, 
The Ĕl of Yisra’ĕl is He 
Who gives strength and power to His people. 
Baruḵ be Elohim!

69.1:
Save me, O Elohim! 
For waters have come up to my neck.
69.2:
I have sunk in deep mud, 
And there is no place to stand; 
I have come into deep waters, 
And the floods overflow me.
69.5:
O Elohim, You Yourself know my foolishness; 
And my guilt has not been hidden from You.
69.6:
Let not those who wait for You, 
O Aḏonai 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts, 
Be ashamed because of me; 
Let not those who seek You 
Be humbled because of me, 
O Elohim of Yisra’ĕl.
69.7:
Because I have borne reproach for Your sake; 
Shame has covered my face.
69.8:
I have become a stranger to my brothers, 
And a foreigner to my mother’s children;
69.9:
Because ardor for Your house has eaten me up, 
And the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen on me.
69.10:
And I wept in my being with fasting, 
And it became my reproach.
69.11:
And when I put on sackcloth, 
I became a proverb to them.
69.12:
They who sit in the gate talk about me, 
And I am the song of the drunkards.
69.13:
But as for me, my prayer is to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
At an acceptable time, O Elohim. 
In the greatness of Your kindness, 
Answer me in the truth of Your deliverance.
69.14:
Rescue me out of the mire, 
And let me not sink. 
Let me be rescued from those who hate me, 
And out of the deep waters.
69.15:
Let not a flood of waters overflow me, 
Nor let the deep swallow me up, 
Nor let the pit shut its mouth on me.
69.16:
Answer me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for Your kindness is good. 
According to the greatness of Your compassion, turn to me.
69.18:
Draw near to my being, redeem it; 
Ransom me because of my enemies.
69.21:
And they gave me gall for my food, 
And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
69.22:
Let their table before them become a snare, 
And a trap to those at ease.
69.23:
Let their eyes be darkened, so as not to see; 
And make their loins shake continually.
69.24:
Pour out Your wrath upon them, 
And let Your burning displeasure overtake them.
69.25:
Let their encampments be deserted; 
Let no one dwell in their tents.
69.26:
For they persecute him whom You have smitten, 
And talk about the pain of those You have wounded.
69.27:
Add wickedness to their wickedness, 
And let them not enter into Your righteousness.
69.28:
Let them be blotted out of the Book of the living, 
And not be written with the righteous.
69.30:
I praise the Name of Elohim with a song, 
And I make Him great with thanksgiving.
69.31:
And this pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 more than an ox, 
A bull with horns, hooves.
69.32:
The humble shall see, they rejoice, 
You who seek Elohim, and your hearts live.
69.33:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 hears the poor; 
And He shall not despise His captives.
69.34:
Let the shamayim and earth praise Him, 
The seas and all that moves in them.
69.35:
For Elohim shall save Tsiyon 
And build the cities of Yahuḏah. 
And they shall dwell there and possess it,
69.36:
And the seed of His servants inherit it, 
And those who love His Name dwell in it.

7.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, my Elohim, in You I have taken refuge; 
Save me from all my pursuers; and deliver me,
7.2:
Lest they tear at my throat like a lion, 
Rending in pieces, with no one to deliver.
7.3:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 my Elohim, if I have done this: 
If there is unrighteousness in my hands,
7.4:
If I have done evil to him who was at peace with me, 
Or have plundered my enemy without cause,
7.5:
Let the enemy pursue me and overtake my being, 
And trample my life to the ground, 
And lay my esteem in the dust. Selah.
7.6:
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, in Your displeasure; 
Lift Yourself up against the rage of my adversaries, 
And awake for me! 
You shall command judgment!
7.7:
And let the congregation of the peoples gather about You; 
And over them return on high.
7.10:
My shield is upon Elohim, 
Who saves the upright in heart.
7.11:
Elohim is a righteous judge. 
And Ĕl is enraged every day,
7.12:
If one does not repent! 
He sharpens His sword, 
He bends His bow and makes it ready,
7.13:
And He has prepared for Himself instruments of death, 
He makes His arrows hot for pursuers.
7.14:
See, he who is bound with wickedness, 
And has conceived trouble and brought forth falsehood,
7.15:
He has made a pit and dug it out, 
And falls into the ditch he made!
7.16:
His trouble turns back upon his own head, 
And his wickedness comes down on the top of his head.
7.17:
I give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 according to His righteousness, 
And praise the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Most High.

70.1:
O Elohim, deliver me! 
Hasten to my help, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄!
70.2:
Let those who seek my life 
Be ashamed and abashed, 
Let those who are desiring my evil 
Be turned back and humiliated.
70.3:
Let those who say, “Aha, aha!” 
Be turned back because of their shame.
70.4:
Let all those who seek You 
Rejoice and be glad in You; 
And let those who love Your deliverance always say, 
“Let Elohim be made great!”

71.1:
In You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, I have taken refuge; 
Let me never be ashamed.
71.2:
In Your righteousness deliver and rescue me; 
Incline Your ear to me, and save me.
71.3:
Be to me a rock to dwell in, 
To go into continually. 
You have given the command to save me, 
For You are my rock and my stronghold.
71.4:
Rescue me, O my Elohim, 
Out of the hand of the wicked, 
Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel.
71.5:
For You are my expectation, 
Aḏonai 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, my trust from my youth.
71.7:
I have become as a wonder to many, 
But You are my strong refuge.
71.8: My mouth is filled, Your praise, Your splendor, all the day.
71.9:
Do not cast me off in the time of old age, 
When my strength fails, do not forsake me.
71.10:
For my enemies have spoken against me. 
And those who watch for my life 
Have taken counsel together,
71.11:
Saying, “Elohim has forsaken him; 
Pursue and take him, for there is no one to deliver.”
71.12:
O Elohim, do not be far from me; 
My Elohim, hasten to my help!
71.13:
Let those who are adversaries of my life 
Be ashamed, consumed, 
Let those who seek my evil 
Be covered with reproach and confusion.
71.14:
But I continually wait, 
And shall praise You more and more.
71.15:
My mouth recounts Your righteousness 
Your deliverance all the day, 
Though I do not know numbers.
71.16:
I come in the might of Aḏonai 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄; 
I make mention of Your righteousness, Yours alone.
71.17:
Elohim, You have taught me from my youth; 
And to this day I declare Your wonders.
71.18:
And also when I am old and grey, 
O Elohim, do not forsake me, 
Until I declare Your strength to a generation, 
Your might to all those who are to come.
71.19:
For Your righteousness, O Elohim, is Most High, 
You who have done greatness. 
O Elohim, who is like You?
71.20:
You who have shown me great and evil distresses, 
Revive me again and bring me up again 
From the depths of the earth.
71.21:
You increase my greatness, 
And comfort me on every side.
71.22:
Also with the lyre I praise You 
For Your trustworthiness, O my Elohim! 
I sing to You with the lyre, 
O Qadosh One of Yisra’ĕl.
71.23:
My lips shout for joy when I sing to You, 
Even my being, which You have redeemed.
71.24:
My tongue, too, utters Your righteousness all day long; 
For those who have been seeking my evil 
Have been put to shame, 
Have become abashed.

72.1:
To Shelomoh. O Elohim, give the meleḵ Your Right-Rulings, 
And Your righteousness to the son of a meleḵ.
72.2:
Let Him rule Your people with righteousness, 
And Your poor with Right-Ruling.
72.3:
Let the mountains bring peace to the people, 
And the hills, by righteousness.
72.4:
Let Him rightly rule the poor of the people, 
Save the children of the needy, 
And crush the oppressor.
72.5:
Let them revere You before the sun, 
And before the moon, in all generations.
72.6:
Let Him come down like rain upon the mown grass, 
Like showers, watering the earth.
72.7:
Let the righteous flourish in His days, 
With plenty of peace, 
Till the moon is no more.
72.8:
And let Him rule from sea to sea, 
And from the River to the ends of the earth.
72.9:
Let those dwelling in the desert bow before Him, 
And His enemies lick the dust.
72.10:
Let the melaḵim of Tarshish and of the isles bring presents; 
The melaḵim of Sheḇa and Seḇa offer gifts.
72.11:
And let all melaḵim bow down before Him, 
All nations serve Him.
72.12:
For He delivers the needy when he cries, 
And the poor, who has no helper.
72.13:
He spares the poor and needy, 
And He saves the lives of the needy.
72.14:
He redeems their life from oppression and from violence; 
And their blood is precious in His eyes.
72.15:
And He shall live, 
And the gold of Sheḇa be given to Him, 
And prayer be made for Him continually; 
Let them baraḵ Him all day long.
72.16:
Let there be plenty of grain in the earth, 
On the top of the mountains, 
Let its fruit wave like Leḇanon, 
And those of the city flourish like grass of the earth.
72.18:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim, 
Elohim of Yisra’ĕl, 
He alone is doing wonders!
72.19:
And baruḵ be His esteemed Name forever! 
And let all the earth 
Be filled with His esteem. 
Amĕn and Amĕn.
72.20: The prayers of Dawiḏ the son of Yishai are ended.

73.1:
A psalm of Asaph. Elohim is truly good to Yisra’ĕl, 
To those whose heart is clean.
73.2:
But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled, 
My steps had nearly slipped.
73.3:
For I was envious of the boasters, 
When I saw the peace of the wicked.
73.4:
For death has no pangs for them, 
And their strength is firm.
73.5:
They are not in trouble as other men, 
And they are not plagued like other men.
73.6:
So pride is their necklace, 
The garment of violence covers them.
73.7:
Their eyes bulge from fatness; 
Their heart overflows with imaginations.
73.8:
They mock and speak in the evil of oppression; 
They speak loftily.
73.9:
They have put their mouth against the shamayim, 
And their tongue walks through the earth,
73.10:
“Therefore His people return here, 
And waters filled are drained by them!”
73.11:
And they have said, “How could Ĕl know? 
And is there knowledge in the Most High?”
73.12:
See, these are the wicked, 
And always at ease, 
They have amassed wealth!
73.13:
Indeed, in vain have I cleansed my heart, 
And washed my hands in innocence.
73.14:
For I am plagued all day long, 
And my reproof is every morning.
73.15:
If I had said, “Let me speak thus,” 
See, I would have deceived 
A generation of Your children.
73.16:
Yet, when I tried to understand this, 
It was labor to my eyes -
73.17:
Until I went into the Miqdash of Ĕl; 
I perceived their end.
73.18:
Indeed, You put them in slippery places; 
You make them fall to ruins.
73.19:
How suddenly they are ruined! 
Completely swept away through destructions.
73.20:
Aḏonai, when You awake 
You despise their image, 
As one does a dream after waking.
73.21:
For my heart was in a ferment, 
And I was pierced in my kidneys.
73.22:
I was stupid and ignorant, 
I was like a beast toward You.
73.23:
Yet I am always with You, 
You took hold of my right hand.
73.24:
You lead me by Your counsel, 
And afterward receive me unto esteem.
73.25:
Whom do I have in the shamayim? 
And I have desired no one besides You on earth.
73.26:
My flesh and my heart shall waste away, 
Elohim is the rock of my heart 
And my portion forever.
73.28:
But as for me, it is good to be near Elohim. 
I have made my refuge in Aḏonai 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
To declare all Your works.

74.1:
A poem of Asaph. O Elohim, why do You forever reject us? 
Why does Your displeasure smoke 
Against the sheep of Your pasture?
74.2:
Remember Your congregation You purchased of old, 
The tribe of Your inheritance You redeemed, 
This Mount Tsiyon where You have dwelt.
74.3:
Lift up Your steps to the endless ruins; 
The enemy has done all evil in the qodesh place.
74.5:
It seems as if one had lifted up 
Axes among the thick trees.
74.6:
And now all its carved work, 
They have broken down with axe and hammer.
74.7:
