They have cast fire into Your Miqdash, 
They have profaned the Mishkan of Your Name to the ground.
74.8:
They said in their hearts, “Let us suppress them altogether.” 
They burned all the meeting places of Ĕl in the land.
74.9:
We do not see our signs, 
There is no longer a naḇi, 
Nor any among us who knows how long.
74.10:
O Elohim, how long would the adversary reproach? 
Would the enemy despise Your Name forever?
74.11:
Why do You hold back Your hand, even Your right hand? 
From the midst of Your bosom - end it!
74.12:
For Elohim is Malki from of old, 
Working deliverance in the midst of the earth.
74.13:
You divided the sea by Your might; 
You broke the heads of the sea serpents in the waters.
74.14:
You broke the heads of Liwiathan in pieces, 
You left him meat for people in the desert.
74.15:
You cleaved the fountain and the flood, 
You dried up mighty rivers.
74.16:
The day is Yours, the night is Yours too, 
You have established the light and the sun.
74.17:
You have appointed all the borders of the earth, 
You have made summer and winter.
74.18:
Remember this: the enemy has reproached 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And a foolish people has despised Your Name.
74.19:
Do not give the being of Your turtledove to the wild beast! 
Do not forget the life of Your afflicted ones forever.
74.20:
Look to the Covenant, 
For the dark places of the earth are filled 
With haunts of violence.
74.21:
Let not the crushed one return ashamed! 
Let the poor and needy praise Your Name.
74.22:
Arise, O Elohim, plead Your own cause, 
Remember how the foolish man reproaches You daily.
74.23:
Do not forget the voice of Your enemies, 
The uproar of those rising up against You increases continually.

75.1:
We shall give thanks to You, 
O Elohim, we shall give thanks! 
And Your Name is near! 
Your wonders shall be declared!
75.2:
“When I seize the appointed time, 
It is I who judge in uprightness.
75.3:
“The earth and all its inhabitants are melted; 
It is I who balances its columns. Selah.
75.4:
“I said to the boasters, ‘Do not boast,’ 
And to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up the horn.
75.5:
“Do not lift up your horn on high - 
You speak with a stiff neck.’ ”
75.6:
For exaltations are neither from the east, 
Nor from the west nor from the wilderness.
75.7:
But Elohim is the Judge - He puts down one, 
And exalts another.
75.8:
For a cup is in the hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And the wine shall foam; 
It is filled with a mixture, 
And He pours it out. 
All the wicked of the earth drink, 
Draining it to the dregs.
75.9:
But I, I declare forever, 
I sing praises to the Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ.
75.10:
“And all the horns of the wicked I cut off; 
The horns of the righteous are lifted up.”

76.1:
In Yahuḏah Elohim is known; 
His Name is great in Yisra’ĕl.
76.2:
And His booth is in Shalĕm, 
And His dwelling place in Tsiyon.
76.3:
There He broke the arrows of the bow, 
The shield and the sword and the battle-axe. Selah.
76.4:
You are resplendent, 
More excellent than mountains of prey.
76.6:
At Your rebuke, O Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ, 
Both the rider and horse lay stunned.
76.8:
From the shamayim You shall cause judgment to be heard; 
The earth shall fear, and shall be still,
76.9:
When Elohim arises to Right-Ruling, 
To save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
76.10:
For the wrath of mankind praises You, 
With the remainder of wrath You gird Yourself!
76.11:
Make vows to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 your Elohim, and pay them. 
Let all who are around Him bring presents 
To the One to be revered.
76.12:
He cuts off the spirit of leaders, 
He is awesome to the melaḵim of the earth!

77.1:
My voice is to Elohim, and I cry; 
My voice is to Elohim, and He listened to me.
77.2:
In the day of my distress I sought Aḏonai; 
My hand was stretched out in the night 
And it did not cease, 
My being refused to be comforted.
77.3:
I remembered Elohim, and groaned; 
I complained, and my spirit grew faint. Selah.
77.4:
You ceased the watches of my eyes, 
I was too troubled to speak.
77.5:
I have thought about the days of old, 
The years long past.
77.6:
I remember my song in the night, 
I meditate within my heart, 
And my spirit searches diligently.
77.7:
Would Aḏonai reject forever, 
And never again be pleased?
77.8:
Has His kindness ceased forever, 
Has the promise failed for all generations?
77.9:
Has Ĕl forgotten to show favor? 
Has He shut up His compassions in displeasure? Selah.
77.10:
And I said, “This is my grief: 
That the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
77.11:
I remember the deeds of Yah, 
For I remember Your wonders of old.
77.12:
And I shall meditate on all Your work, 
And talk of Your deeds.
77.13:
Your Way, O Elohim, is in Qodeshah 
Who is a great Ĕl like Elohim?
77.14:
You are the Ĕl who does wonders; 
You have made known Your strength among the peoples.
77.15:
By Your arm You have redeemed Your people, 
The sons of Ya’aqoḇ and Yosĕph. Selah.
77.19:
Your way was in the sea, 
And Your path in the great waters, 
And Your footsteps were not known.
77.20:
You led Your people like a flock 
By the hand of Mosheh and Aharon.

78.1:
A poem of Asaph. My people, give ear to my Torah, 
Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
78.2:
I open my mouth in a parable; 
I utter riddles of old,
78.3:
Which we have heard and known, 
For our fathers have declared to us.
78.4:
We do not hide from their children, 
Declaring to the generation to come the praises of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And His strength and His wonders which He has done.
78.5:
For He raised a witness in Ya’aqoḇ, 
And put a Torah in Yisra’ĕl, 
Which He commanded our fathers, 
To teach them to their children;
78.6:
That it might be known to a generation to come, 
To children who would be born, 
To rise up and declare to their children,
78.7:
And place their trust in Elohim, 
And not forget the works of Ĕl, 
But watch over His Commands,
78.8:
And not be like their fathers, 
A stubborn and rebellious generation, 
A generation which did not prepare its heart, 
Whose spirit was not steadfast to Ĕl.
78.9:
The children of Ephrayim, armed bow archers, 
Turned back in the day of battle.
78.10:
They did not guard the Covenant of Elohim, 
And they refused to walk in His Torah,
78.11:
And they forgot His deeds 
And His wonders which He had shown them.
78.12:
He did wonders in the sight of their fathers, 
In the land of Mitsrayim, in the field of Tso’an.
78.13:
He split the sea and caused them to pass through, 
And He made the waters stand up like a heap,
78.14:
And led them with the cloud by day, 
And all the night with a light of fire.
78.15:
He split the rocks in the wilderness, 
And made them drink, as from the great depths,
78.16:
And brought forth streams from the rock, 
And caused waters to come down as rivers.
78.17:
Yet they sinned still more against Him 
To rebel against the Most High in the desert.
78.18:
And they tried Ĕl in their heart 
By asking food according to their desire.
78.19:
And they spoke against Elohim. 
They said, “Is Ĕl able to prepare a table in the wilderness?
78.20:
“Look, He struck the rock, 
So that the waters gushed out, 
And the streams overflowed. 
Is He able to give bread also? 
Would He provide meat for His people?”
78.22:
Because they did not believe in Elohim, 
Neither did they trust in His deliverance.
78.23:
Yet He had commanded the clouds above, 
And opened the doors of the shamayim,
78.24:
And He rained down manna on them to eat, 
And He gave them the grain of the shamayim.
78.25:
Men ate bread of the mighty; 
He sent them provisions to satisfaction.
78.26:
He made an east wind blow in the shamayim; 
And by His power He brought in the south wind.
78.27:
And He rained meat on them like the dust, 
And winged birds like the sand of the seas,
78.28:
And let them fall in the midst of His camp, 
All around His Mishkan.
78.29:
So they ate and were completely satisfied, 
For He brought them what they desired.
78.30:
They had not turned away from their desire, 
Their food was still in their mouths,
78.31:
When the wrath of Elohim came against them, 
And He slew among their fat ones, 
And He struck down the choice ones of Yisra’ĕl.
78.32:
In spite of all this they still sinned, 
And did not believe in His wonders.
78.33:
So He ended their days in a breath, 
And their years in trouble.
78.34:
When He slew them, then they sought Him, 
And they returned and earnestly sought Ĕl.
78.35:
And they remembered that Elohim was their rock, 
And the Most High Ĕl their redeemer.
78.36:
But they flattered Him with their mouth, 
And they lied to Him with their tongue,
78.37:
For their heart was not steadfast with Him, 
And they were not true to His Covenant.
78.38:
But He, the Compassionate One, 
Pardoned wickedness, 
And did not destroy them. 
And many a time He turned His displeasure away, 
And did not stir up all His wrath.
78.39:
For He remembered that they were but flesh, 
A passing breath that does not return.
78.40:
How often they rebelled against Him in the wilderness, 
And grieved Him in the desert!
78.41:
And again and again they tried Ĕl, 
And provoked the Qadosh One of Yisra’ĕl.
78.42:
They did not remember His hand, 
The day when He redeemed them from the adversary,
78.43:
How He worked His signs in Mitsrayim, 
And His wonders in the field of Tso’an.
78.44:
He turned their rivers into blood, 
And they could not drink their streams.
78.45:
He sent among them swarms of flies which devoured them, 
And frogs which destroyed them,
78.46:
And gave their crops to the caterpillar, 
And their labor to the locust.
78.47:
He destroyed their vines with hail, 
And their sycamore trees with frost,
78.48:
And gave their beasts over to the hail, 
And their livestock to bolts of fire.
78.49:
He sent on them the burning of His displeasure, 
Wrath, and rage, and distress, 
A deputation of messengers of evils.
78.51:
And He smote all the first-born in Mitsrayim, 
The first-fruits of strength in the tents of Ḥam,
78.52:
Then made His own people go forth like sheep, 
And led them in the wilderness like a flock,
78.53:
And He led them on safely, 
And they did not fear, 
But the sea covered their enemies.
78.54:
And He brought them to the border of His qodesh place, 
This mountain which His right hand had gained,
78.55:
And drove out nations before them, 
And allotted them a measured inheritance, 
And made the tribes of Yisra’ĕl dwell in their tents.
78.56:
Yet they tried and rebelled 
Against the Most High Elohim, 
And did not guard His Witnesses,
78.58:
For they enraged Him with their high places, 
And moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.
78.59:
When Elohim heard this, He was wroth, 
And greatly despised Yisra’ĕl,
78.60:
And He left the Mishkan of Shiloh, 
The Tent which He had put up among men.
78.61:
And He gave His strength into captivity 
And His comeliness into the hand of the adversary.
78.62:
And He gave His people over to the sword, 
And He was wroth with His inheritance.
78.63:
His young men were consumed by fire, 
And His maidens were not praised.
78.64:
His kohenim fell by the sword, 
And their widows could not weep.
78.65:
Then Aḏonai awoke as one asleep, 
As a mighty man who shouts because of wine.
78.66:
And He smote His adversaries backward; 
He put them to an everlasting reproach.
78.67:
Then He rejected the tent of Yosĕph, 
And did not choose the tribe of Ephrayim,
78.68:
But chose the tribe of Yahuḏah, 
Mount Tsiyon, which He loved.
78.69:
And He built His Miqdash like the heights, 
Like the earth He founded it forever.
78.70:
And He chose Dawiḏ His servant, 
And took him from the sheepfolds;
78.71:
He brought him in from tending the ewes, 
To shepherd Ya’aqoḇ His people, 
And Yisra’ĕl His inheritance.
78.72:
And he shepherded them 
According to the integrity of his heart, 
And led them by the skill of his hands.

79.2:
They have given the dead bodies of Your servants 
As food for the birds of the shamayim, 
The flesh of Your kind ones to the wild beast of the earth.
79.3:
They have poured out their blood 
Like water all around Yerushalayim, 
With no one to bury.
79.4:
We have become a reproach to our neighbors, 
A scorn and a mockery to those who are around us.
79.5:
How long, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Would You be enraged forever? 
Would Your jealousy burn like fire?
79.6:
Pour out Your wrath on the gentiles 
Who have not known You, 
And on reigns that have not called on Your Name
79.7:
For they have devoured Ya’aqoḇ, 
And laid waste his pasture.
79.8:
Do not remember against us 
The wickednesses of the fathers! 
Let Your compassion speedily meet us, 
For we have been greatly weakened.
79.9:
Help us, O Elohim of our deliverance, 
For the sake of the esteem of Your Name. 
And deliver us, and cover over our sins, 
For Your Name’s sake!
79.10:
Why should the gentiles say, 
“Where is their Elohim?” 
Let the vengeance of the outpoured blood of Your servants 
Be known among the gentiles, 
Before our eyes.
79.11:
Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You. 
According to the greatness of Your arm 
Preserve those appointed to death.
79.12:
And repay to our neighbors sevenfold 
Their reproach, into their bosom, 
With which they have reproached You, O Aḏonai.

8.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, our Aḏon, how excellent is Your Name in all the earth, 
You who made Your splendor above the shamayim!
8.2:
Out of the mouth of children and infants 
You have founded strength, 
Because of Your adversaries, 
To put an end to enemy and avenger.
8.3:
For I see Your shamayim, the work of Your fingers, 
The moon and the stars, which You have established.
8.4:
What is man that You remember him? 
And the son of man that You visit him?
8.5:
Yet You have made him a little less than Elohim, 
And have crowned him with esteem and splendor.
8.6:
You made him rule over the works of Your hands; 
You have put all under his feet,
8.7:
All sheep and oxen, 
And also the beasts of the field,
8.8:
The birds of the shamayim, and the fish of the sea, 
Passing through the paths of the seas.
8.9:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, our Aḏon, 
How excellent is Your Name in all the earth!

80.2:
Before Ephrayim, Binyamin, and Menashsheh, 
Stir up Your might, 
And come and save us!
80.3:
Cause us to turn back, O Elohim, 
And cause Your face to shine, 
That we might be saved!
80.4:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of hosts, 
How long shall You be wroth 
Against the prayer of Your people?
80.5:
You have caused them to eat the bread of tears, 
And have caused them to drink 
With tears, a third time.
80.6:
You have made us a strife to our neighbors, 
And our enemies laugh among themselves.
80.7:
Turn us back, O Elohim of hosts, 
And cause Your face to shine, 
That we might be saved!
80.8:
You brought a vine out of Mitsrayim; 
You drove out the nations, and planted it.
80.9:
You cleared a place for it, 
And caused it to take deep root, 
And it filled the land.
80.10:
Hills were covered with its shadow, 
And the mighty cedars with its twigs.
80.11:
She spread her branches to the Sea, 
And her shoots to the River.
80.12:
Why have You broken down her hedges, 
So that every passer-by plucked her fruit?
80.13:
The boar out of the forest ravages it, 
And the wild beast of the field devours it.
80.15:
And the stock which Your right hand has planted, 
And the Bĕn whom You made strong for Yourself.
80.16:
It is burned with fire, it is cut down; 
They perish at the rebuke of Your face.
80.17:
Let Your hand be upon the One at Your right hand, 
Upon the Bĕn of Aḏam whom You made strong for Yourself,
80.18:
And we shall not backslide from You. 
Revive us, and let us call upon Your Name.
80.19:
Turn us back, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of hosts, 
And cause Your face to shine, 
That we might be saved!

81.1:
Shout for joy to Elohim our strength; 
Raise a shout to the Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ.
81.2:
Lift up a song and beat the tambourine, 
The pleasant lyre and with the harp.
81.3:
Blow the ram’s horn at the time of the New Moon, 
At the covering, on our Festival day.
81.4:
For this is a Law for Yisra’ĕl, 
And a Right-Ruling of the Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ.
81.6:
“I removed his shoulder from the burden; 
His hands were freed from the baskets.
81.8:
“Hear, O My people, and let Me warn you, 
O Yisra’ĕl, if you would listen to Me!
81.9:
“Let there be no strange mighty one among you, 
And do not bow down to a foreign mighty one.
81.11:
“But My people did not listen to My voice, 
And Yisra’ĕl would not submit to Me.
81.12:
“So I gave them over to their own stubborn heart, 
To walk in their own counsels.
81.13:
“O, if My people had listened to Me, 
Yisra’ĕl would walk in My Ways,
81.14:
“I would subdue their enemies at once, 
And turn My hand against their adversaries!
81.15:
“Those who hate 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 would cringe before Him; 
And their time be forever.
81.16:
“He would feed them with the finest of wheat; 
And with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”

82.1:
A psalm of Asaph. Elohim stands in the congregation of the mighty; 
He judges in the midst of the mighty ones.
82.2:
How long would you judge perversely, 
And show partiality to the wicked? Selah.
82.3:
Give right-ruling to the poor and fatherless, 
Do right to the afflicted and needy.
82.4:
Rescue the poor and needy; 
Deliver them from the hand of the wicked.
82.5:
They do not know, nor do they understand, 
They walk about in darkness. 
All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
82.6:
I, I said, “You are Elohim, 
And all of you are sons of the Most High.
82.7:
“But as men you die, 
And fall as one of the heads.”
82.8:
Arise, O Elohim, judge the earth, 
For You shall possess all the nations.

83.1:
O Elohim, do not remain silent! 
Do not be speechless, 
And do not be still, O Ĕl!
83.2:
For look, Your enemies make an uproar, 
And those hating You have lifted up their head.
83.3:
They craftily plot against Your people, 
And conspire against Your treasured ones.
83.4:
They have said, “Come, 
And let us wipe them out as a nation, 
And let the name of Yisra’ĕl be remembered no more.”
83.5:
For they have conspired together with one heart; 
They have made a covenant against You -
83.6:
The tents of Eḏom and the Yishma’ĕlites, 
Mo’aḇ and the Haḡrites,
83.7:
Geḇel, and Ammon, and Amalĕq, 
Pelesheth with the inhabitants of Tsor,
83.8:
Ashshur also has joined with them, 
They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.
83.9:
Do to them as to Miḏyan, 
As to Sisera, 
As to Yaḇin at the wadi Qishon,
83.10:
Who perished at Ĕyn Dor, 
Who became as dung for the ground.
83.11:
Make their nobles like Orĕḇ and like Ze’ĕḇ, 
And all their princes like Zeḇaḥ and Tsalmunna,
83.12:
Who have said, “Let us take possession of the pastures of Elohim 
For ourselves.”
83.13:
O my Elohim, make them as whirling dust, 
As stubble before the wind!
83.14:
As a fire consumes a forest, 
And as a flame lights mountains on fire,
83.15:
So pursue them with Your whirlwind, 
And frighten them with Your storm.
83.16:
Fill their faces with shame, 
And let them seek Your Name, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
83.17:
Let them be ashamed and alarmed forever; 
And let them become abashed and perish,

84.1:
How lovely are Your Mishkanoth, 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts!
84.3:
Even the sparrow has found a home, 
And the swallow a nest for herself, 
Where she has put her young ones - 
Your altars, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts, 
Malki and my Elohim.
84.4:
Ashrĕ are those who dwell in Your House, 
They are ever praising You. Selah.
84.5:
Ashrĕ is the man whose strength is in You, 
Highways are in their heart.
84.7:
They go from strength to strength, 
Appearing before Elohim in Tsiyon.
84.8:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of hosts, hear my prayer; 
Give ear, O Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ! Selah.
84.9:
O Elohim, see our shield, 
And look upon the face of Your anointed.
84.10:
For a day in Your courts 
Is better than a thousand. 
I have chosen rather to be a door-keeper 
In the House of my Elohim, 
Than to dwell in the tents of the wicked.
84.12:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 of hosts, 
Ashrĕ is the man who trusts in You!

85.1:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, You shall take pleasure in Your land; 
You shall turn back the captivity of Ya’aqoḇ.
85.2:
You shall take away the wickedness of Your people; 
You shall cover all their sin. Selah.
85.3:
You shall withdraw all Your wrath; 
You shall turn from Your fierce displeasure.
85.4:
Turn back to us, O Elohim of our deliverance, 
And cause Your wrath toward us to cease.
85.5:
Would You be enraged with us forever? 
Would You draw out Your displeasure 
From generation to generation?
85.6:
Would You not revive us again, 
For Your people to rejoice in You?
85.7:
Show us Your kindness, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And give us Your deliverance.
85.8:
Let me hear what Ĕl 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 speaks, 
For He speaks peace to His people 
And to His kind ones; 
And let them not turn again to folly.
85.9:
Truly, His deliverance is near to those who revere Him, 
For esteem to dwell in our land.
85.10:
Kindness and truth shall meet, 
Righteousness and peace shall touch.
85.11:
Truth sprouts forth from the earth, 
And righteousness looks down from the shamayim,
85.12:
Indeed, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 gives what is good, 
And our land yields its increase.
85.13:
Righteousness goes before Him, 
And prepares a way for His footsteps.

86.1:
A prayer of Dawiḏ. Incline Your ear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Answer me, for I am poor and needy.
86.3:
Show favor to me, O Aḏonai, 
For I cry to You all day long.
86.4:
Bring joy to the being of Your servant, 
For to You, O Aḏonai, I lift up my being.
86.5:
For You, Aḏonai, are good, and ready to forgive, 
And great in kindness to all those who call upon You.
86.6:
Give ear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, to my prayer; 
And listen to the voice of my pleadings.
86.7:
In the day of my distress I call upon You, 
For You answer me.
86.8:
There is none like You among the mighty ones, O Aḏonai; 
And like Your works there are none.
86.9:
Let all nations You have made 
Come and bow themselves before You, O Aḏonai, 
And give esteem to Your Name.
86.10:
For You are great, and are doing wonders; 
You are Elohim, You alone.
86.12:
I praise You, O Aḏonai my Elohim, with all my heart, 
And I esteem Your Name forever.
86.13:
For Your kindness is great toward me, 
And You have delivered my being 
From the depths of the grave.
86.14:
O Elohim, the proud have risen against me, 
And a band of dreaded men have sought my life, 
And have not put You before them.
86.15:
But You, O Aḏonai, 
Are a compassionate Ĕl and showing favor, 
Patient and great in kindness and truth.
86.16:
Turn to me, and show favor to me! 
Give Your strength to Your servant, 
And save the son of Your female servant.
86.17:
Show me a sign for good, 
And let those hating me see it and be ashamed, 
For You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, have helped me and comforted me.

87.1: A psalm, a song, for the sons of Qoraḥ. His foundation is in the qodesh mountains.
87.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 loves the gates of Tsiyon 
More than all the dwellings of Ya’aqoḇ.
87.3:
Esteem is spoken of you, 
O city of Elohim: Selah.
87.6:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 writes, In the register of the peoples, 
“This one was born there.” Selah.
87.7:
And the singers and the players on instruments - 
All my fountains, are in you.

88.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Elohim of my deliverance, 
By day I have cried out, 
In the night before You,
88.2:
Let my prayer come before You, 
Incline Your ear to my cry.
88.3:
For my being is filled with evils, 
And my life draws near to the grave.
88.4:
I have been reckoned among those 
Who go down to the pit; 
I have become like a man 
Who has no strength,
88.5:
Released among the dead, 
Like slain ones lying in the grave, 
Whom You have remembered no more, 
And who have been cut off from Your hand.
88.6:
You have put me in the lowest pit, 
In dark places, in the depths.
88.7:
Your wrath has rested heavily upon me, 
And You have afflicted me with all Your breakers. Selah.
88.10:
Would You work wonders for the dead? 
Would the dead rise to praise You? Selah.
88.11:
Is Your kindness declared in the grave? 
Your trustworthiness in the place of destruction?
88.12:
Are Your wonders known in the dark? 
And Your righteousness in the land of no remembrance?
88.13:
But I, unto You I have cried, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And in the morning my prayer comes before You.
88.14:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, why do You reject me? 
Why do You hide Your face from me?
88.16:
Your fierce wrath has gone over me; 
Your onslaughts have cut me off.
88.17:
They surrounded me like water all day long; 
They close in upon me altogether.
88.18:
You have put loved one and companion far from me, 
Darkness is my close friend!

89.2:
For I said, “Kindness is built up forever; 
You establish Your trustworthiness in the shamayim.”
89.3:
“I have made a Covenant with My chosen, 
I have sworn to My servant Dawiḏ:
89.4:
‘I establish your seed forever, 
And shall build up your throne to all generations.’ ” Selah.
89.5:
And the shamayim praise Your wonders, 
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Your trustworthiness, too, 
In the assembly of the qodeshim.
89.6:
For who in the shamayim is comparable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄? 
Who among the sons of the mighty is like 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄?
89.7:
Ĕl is greatly revered 
In the company of the qodeshim, 
And awesome above all those around Him.
89.8:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Elohim of hosts, 
Who is mighty like You, O Yah? 
And Your trustworthiness is all around You.
89.11:
The shamayim are Yours, 
The earth also is Yours; 
The world and all that fills it. 
You have founded them.
89.12:
North and south - You have created them; 
Taḇor and Ḥermon rejoice in Your Name.
89.13:
You have a mighty arm, 
Your hand is strong, 
Your right hand exalted.
89.15:
Ashrĕ are the people 
Who know the trumpet-call! 
They walk, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, in the light of Your face.
89.16:
In Your Name they rejoice all day long, 
And they are exalted in Your righteousness.
89.17:
For You are the comeliness of their strength, 
And by Your good pleasure our horn is exalted.
89.18:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is our shield, 
And the Qadosh One of Yisra’ĕl is our Meleḵ.
89.19:
Then You spoke in a vision to Your kind one, 
And You said, “I have given help to one who is mighty, 
I have exalted one chosen from the people.
89.20:
“I have found My servant Dawiḏ; 
With My qodesh oil I anointed him,
89.21:
“With whom My hand is established; 
My arm also strengthens him.
89.22:
“No enemy subjects him to tribute, 
And no son of wickedness afflicts him.
89.23:
“And I shall beat down His adversaries before his face, 
And plague those who hate him.
89.24:
“But My trustworthiness 
And My kindness are with him, 
And in My Name his horn is exalted.
89.25:
“And I shall put his hand on the sea, 
And his right hand on the rivers.
89.26:
“He calls out to Me, ‘You are my Father, 
My Ĕl, and the rock of my deliverance.’
89.27:
“I also appoint him first-born, 
Highest of the melaḵim of the earth.
89.28:
“I guard My kindness for him forever, 
And My Covenant is steadfast with him.
89.29:
“And I shall establish his seed forever, 
And his throne as the days of the shamayim.
89.30:
“If his sons forsake My Torah 
And do not walk in My Right-Rulings,
89.31:
“If they profane My Laws 
And do not guard My Commands,
89.32:
“Then I shall visit their transgression with the rod, 
And their wickedness with flogging.
89.33:
“But My kindness I do not take away from him, 
Nor be false to My trustworthiness.
89.34:
“I shall not profane My Covenant, 
Neither would I change what has gone out from My lips.
89.35:
“Once I have sworn by Qodeshah, 
I do not lie to Dawiḏ:
89.36:
“His seed shall be forever, 
And his throne as the sun before Me;
89.37:
“Like the moon, it is established forever, 
And the witness in the shamayim is steadfast.” Selah.
89.38:
Yet You have rejected and spurned, 
You have been wroth with Your anointed.
89.39:
You have disowned the Covenant of Your servant, 
You have defiled his diadem in the dust.
89.40:
You have broken down all his hedges, 
You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
89.41:
All who pass by the way plunder him; 
He is a reproach to his neighbors.
89.42:
You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries, 
You have made all his enemies rejoice.
89.43:
Moreover You have turned back the edge of his sword, 
And have not made him stand in battle.
89.44:
You have brought an end to his splendor, 
And have hurled his throne to the ground.
89.45:
You have shortened the days of his youth, 
You have covered him with shame. Selah.
89.46:
How long, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, would You be hidden? 
Would Your wrath burn like fire forever?
89.47:
Please remember how short my time is; 
Why should you have created all the sons of men for naught?
89.48:
What man would live and not see death? 
Who rescues his life from the power of the grave? Selah.
89.49:
Aḏonai, where are Your former kindnesses, 
Which You swore to Dawiḏ in Your trustworthiness?
89.50:
Aḏonai, remember the reproach of Your servants, 
That I have borne in my bosom - 
Of all the many peoples,
89.51:
With which Your enemies have reproached, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
With which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.
89.52:
Baruḵ be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 forever! 
Amĕn and Amĕn.

9.1:
I praise You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, with all my heart; 
I declare all Your wonders.
9.2:
I rejoice and exult in You; 
I sing praise to Your Name, O Most High.
9.3:
When my enemies turn back, 
They stumble and perish before You.
9.4:
For You executed my right and my cause, 
You sat on the throne judging in righteousness.
9.5:
You have rebuked the gentiles, 
You have destroyed the wicked, 
You have wiped out their name forever and ever.
9.7:
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 abides forever, 
He is preparing His throne for judgment.
9.8:
And He judges the world in righteousness, 
He judges the peoples in straightness.
9.9:
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is a refuge for the crushed one, 
A refuge in times of distress.
9.10:
And those who know Your Name trust in You, 
For You have not forsaken those who seek You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
9.11:
Sing praises to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, who dwells in Tsiyon! 
Declare His deeds among the peoples.
9.12:
For He remembers the seekers of bloodshed, 
He does not forget the cry of the afflicted.
9.13:
Show favor to me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
See my affliction by those who hate me, 
You who lift me up from the gates of death,
9.14:
So that I declare all Your praise 
In the gates of the daughter of Tsiyon. 
I rejoice in Your deliverance.
9.15:
The gentiles have sunk down in the pit which they made; 
In the net which they hid, their own foot is caught.
9.16:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has made Himself known,
He has done right-ruling; 
The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. 
Meditation. Selah.
9.17:
The wicked return to the grave, 
All the gentiles that forget Elohim.
9.18:
For the needy is not always forgotten; 
Neither the expectancy of the poor lost forever.
9.20:
Put them in fear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Let the gentiles know they are mortal. Selah.

90.1:
A prayer of Mosheh, the man of Elohim. Aḏonai, You have been our refuge 
In all generations.
90.2:
Before the mountains were born, 
Or You had brought forth the earth and the world, 
Even from everlasting to everlasting You are Ĕl.
90.3:
You turn man back to dust, 
And say, “Return, O children of men.”
90.4:
For a thousand years in Your eyes 
Are like yesterday that has past, 
Or like a watch in the night.
90.5:
You have swept them away as they sleep, 
Like grass that springs up in the morning.
90.6:
In the morning it flourishes and springs up, 
At evening it is cut down and withered.
90.7:
For we have been consumed by Your displeasure, 
And by Your wrath we are alarmed.
90.8:
You have laid our wickednesses before You, 
Our hidden ways in the light of Your face.
90.9:
For all our days have passed away in Your wrath, 
We spend our years like a whisper.
90.11:
Who knows the power of Your displeasure? 
And Your wrath, according to the fear of You?
90.12:
Teach us to number our days, 
And let us bring the heart to wisdom.
90.13:
Return, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! How long? 
And be sorry for Your servants.
90.14:
Satisfy us in the morning with Your kindness, 
And let us sing for joy all our days!
90.15:
Give us joy according to 
The days You have afflicted us, 
The years we have seen evil.
90.16:
Reveal Your work to Your servants, 
And Your splendor to their children.
90.17:
And let the pleasantness 
Of Aḏonai our Elohim be upon us, 
And confirm the work of our hands for us; 
O confirm the work of our hands!

91.1:
He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High, 
Who abides under the shadow of Ĕl Shaddai,
91.2:
He is saying of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
“My refuge and my stronghold, 
My Elohim, in whom I trust!”
91.3:
For He delivers you from the snare of a trapper, 
From the destructive pestilence.
91.5:
You are not afraid of the dread by night, 
Of the arrow that flies by day,
91.6:
Of the pestilence that walks in darkness, 
Of destruction that ravages at midday.
91.8:
Only with your eyes you look on, 
And see the reward of the wicked.
91.9:
Because you have made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 - 
My refuge, the Most High - your dwelling place,
91.10:
No evil befalls you, 
And a plague does not come near your tent;
91.11:
For He commands His messengers concerning you, 
To guard you in all your ways.
91.12:
They bear you up in their hands, 
Lest you dash your foot against a stone.
91.13:
You tread upon lion and cobra, 
Young lion and serpent you trample underfoot.
91.14:
“Because he clings to Me in love, 
Therefore I deliver him; 
I exalt him, 
Because he has known My Name.
91.16:
“With long life I satisfy him, 
And show him My deliverance.”

92.2:
To declare Your kindness in the morning, 
And Your trustworthiness each night,
92.3:
On ten strings, and on the harp, 
To the sounding chords of the lyre.
92.4:
For You have made me rejoice with Your work, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
I shout for joy at the works of Your hands.
92.5:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, how great are Your works! 
Your thoughts are very deep!
92.6:
A senseless man does not know, 
And a fool does not understand this.
92.7:
When the wicked spring up like grass, 
And all the workers of wickedness blossom, 
It is for them to be destroyed forever.
92.8: But You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, are on high forever.
92.10:
But You lift up my horn like a wild ox; 
I have been anointed with fresh oil.
92.12:
The righteous one flourishes like a palm tree, 
He grows like a cedar in Leḇanon.
92.13:
Those who are planted in the House of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 
Flourish in the courts of our Elohim.
92.14:
They still bear fruit in old age; 
They are fresh and green,
92.15:
To declare that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is straight, 
My rock, and in Him is no unrighteousness.

93.2:
Your throne is established from of old; 
You are from everlasting.
93.4:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 on high is mightier 
Than the noise of many waters, 
The mighty breakers of the sea.
93.5:
Your Witnesses have been very trustworthy. 
Qodeshah befits Your house, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, forever.

94.1:
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, Ĕl of vengeance; 
O Ĕl of vengeance, shine forth!
94.2:
Raise Yourself up, O Judge of the earth; 
Render punishment to the proud.
94.3:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, how long are the wicked, 
How long are the wicked going to exult?
94.5:
They crush Your people, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
And they afflict Your inheritance.
94.6:
They slay the widow and the stranger, 
And murder the fatherless.
94.7:
Yet they say, “Yah does not see, 
And the Elohim of Ya’aqoḇ pays no heed.”
94.8:
Take heed, you senseless among the people; 
And you fools, when would you become wise?
94.9:
He who planted the ear, does He not hear? 
He who formed the eye, does He not see?
94.10:
He who disciplines the nations, 
Does He not reprove - 
The One teaching man knowledge?
94.11:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 knows the thoughts of man, 
That they are a breath.
94.12:
Ashrĕ is the man You discipline, O Yah, 
And instruct out of Your Torah,
94.13:
To give him rest from the days of evil, 
Until the pit is dug for the wicked.
94.14:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 does not leave His people, 
Nor does He forsake His inheritance.
94.15:
For Right-Ruling returns to righteousness, 
And all the upright in heart follow it.
94.16:
Who would rise up for me against evil-doers? 
Who would stand up for me against workers of wickedness?
94.17:
If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 had not been my help, 
My being would soon have settled in silence.
94.18:
When I said, “My foot has slipped,” 
Your kindness, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, supported me.
94.19:
When anxiety was great within me, 
Your comforts delighted my being.
94.20:
Would a throne of destruction, 
Which devises trouble by law, 
Be joined with You?
94.21:
They band together against the life of the righteous, 
And declare innocent blood wicked.
94.22:
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is my defense, 
And my Elohim the rock of my refuge,

95.1:
Come, let us sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄! 
Let us raise a shout to the Rock of our deliverance.
95.2:
Let us come before His face with thanksgiving; 
Let us raise a shout to Him in song.
95.3:
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is a great Ĕl, 
And a great Meleḵ above all mighty ones.
95.4:
In whose hand are the depths of the earth; 
The mountain peaks are His also.
95.5:
His is the sea, for He made it; 
And His hands formed the dry land.
95.6:
Come, let us bow down and bend low, 
Let us kneel before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Maker.
95.7:
For He is our Elohim, 
And we are the people of His pasture, 
And the sheep of His hand. 
Today, if you would hear His voice:
95.8:
“Do not harden your hearts as in Meriḇah, 
And as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,
95.9:
“When your fathers tried Me, 
Have proved Me, though they saw My work.
95.10:
“For forty years I was loathed with a generation, 
And said, ‘They are a people who go astray in their hearts, 
And they do not know My Ways.’
95.11: “As I swore in My wrath, ‘If they enter into My rest…’ ”

96.1:
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 a new song, 
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, all the earth!
96.2:
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, baraḵ His Name, 
Proclaim His deliverance from day to day.
96.3:
Declare His esteem among the nations, 
His wonders among all peoples.
96.4:
For great is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 and greatly to be praised, 
He is to be revered above all mighty ones.
96.5:
For all the mighty ones of the peoples are matters of naught, 
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 made the shamayim.
96.6:
Excellency and splendor are before Him, 
Strength and comeliness are in His Miqdash.
96.7:
Ascribe to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, O clans of the peoples, 
Ascribe to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 esteem and strength.
96.8:
Ascribe to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 the esteem of His Name; 
Bring an offering, and come into His courts.
96.9:
Bow yourselves to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
In the splendor of qodeshah! 
Tremble before Him, all the earth.
96.10:
Say among nations, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall reign. 
The world also is established, immovable. 
He judges the peoples in straightness.”
96.11:
Let the shamayim rejoice, and let the earth be glad; 
Let the sea roar, and all that fills it;
96.12:
Let the field exult, and all that is in it. 
Let all the trees of the forest then shout for joy,
96.13:
At the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄. 
For He shall come, 
For He shall come to judge the earth. 
He judges the world in righteousness, 
And the peoples with His truth.

97.1:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 shall reign. 
The earth rejoices. 
Many isles are glad!
97.2:
Clouds and thick cloud all around Him, 
Righteousness and Right-Ruling are the foundation of His throne.
97.3:
Fire goes before Him, 
And burns up His adversaries round about.
97.4:
His lightnings shall light the world, 
The earth shall see and tremble.
97.5:
The mountains shall melt like wax before the face of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, 
Before the face of the Aḏon of all the earth.
97.6:
The shamayim shall declare His righteousness, 
And all the peoples shall see His esteem.
97.7:
All are put to shame who serve carved images, 
Those boasting of matters of naught. 
Bow yourselves to Him, all you mighty ones.
97.8:
Tsiyon shall hear and be glad, 
And the daughters of Yahuḏah rejoice 
Because of Your Right-Rulings, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄.
97.9:
For You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, are the Most High over all the earth, 
You shall be greatly exalted, over all mighty ones.
97.10:
You who love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, hate evil! 
He guards the lives of His kind ones, 
He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
97.11:
Light is sown for the righteous, 
And gladness for the upright in heart.
97.12:
Rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, you righteous, 
And give thanks at the remembrance of His Qodeshah.

98.1:
A psalm. Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 a new song! 
For He has done wonders; 
His right hand and His qodesh arm 
Have brought Him deliverance.
98.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 has made known His deliverance; 
His righteousness 
He has openly shown 
Before the eyes of the nations.
98.3:
He has remembered His kindness 
And His trustworthiness to the house of Yisra’ĕl; 
All the ends of the earth have seen 
The deliverance of our Elohim.
98.4:
Raise a shout to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, all the earth; 
Break forth in song, rejoice, and sing praises.
98.5:
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 with the lyre, 
With the lyre and the voice of a song,
98.6:
With trumpets and the sound of a ram’s horn; 
Raise a shout before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, the Meleḵ.
98.7:
Let the sea roar, and all that fills it, 
The world and those who dwell in it.
98.8:
Let the rivers clap their hands, 
Let the mountains sing together for joy.
98.9:
Before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, for He shall come to judge the earth. 
He judges the world in righteousness, 
And the people in straightness.

99.2:
𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is great in Tsiyon, 
And He is high above all the peoples.
99.3:
They praise Your Name, great and awesome, 
It is qodesh.
99.5:
Exalt 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim, 
And bow yourselves at His footstool, 
He is qodesh.
99.6:
Mosheh and Aharon were among His kohenim, 
And Shemu’ĕl was among those calling upon His Name. 
They called upon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄, and He answered them.
99.8:
You answered them, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 our Elohim. 
You were a forgiving Ĕl to them, 
Though You took vengeance on their deeds.
